programme.title: How Fans Are Taking Power In The Sports Media Business
programme.desc: Fans used to call into sports radio. Now they’re building media companies of their own. CP, founder and CEO of Knicks Fan TV, Rebecca Chasen of Knicks Film School, and Shaun of The Knicks Wall join Ian Schafer to explore how independent creators are turning sports fandom into audiences, influence, and revenue—and changing who holds power in sports media. Using the Knicks as a case study, they unpack the business behind live shows, sponsorships, merchandise, and fan events; why direct relationships with audiences give creators an advantage; and what it takes to grow a community into a company. As the lines between fan, creator, and insider blur, what can traditional networks learn from the people building outside them?

programme.title: ABANDONED
programme.desc: Twenty-two years ago, a 10-year-old boy went to the park with his mother and sister. They rode the carousel and played in the grass. His mom and sister left for what was supposed to be a brief trip to the store, but they never came back. Dr. Phil works to unravel this mystery. Follow the little boy's heartbreaking search for the mother and sister who left him behind. Dr. Phil unravels the mystery. Follow the little boy's heartbreaking search for the mother and sister who left him behind.

programme.title: Heroin Twins
programme.desc: Brandon is a drug addict in recovery who credits Dr. Phil’s intervention with saving his life. Now, he and his mother, Debbie, pay it forward by staging interventions for families and their drug addicted loved ones. Dee saw an episode with Brandon and wrote to Dr. Phil for help with her 23-year-old twin daughters, Brooke and Tiffany, who are addicted to heroin and other prescription drugs. Both women have young children, who are often left to parent each other, as well as take care of their sick mothers. Dee and her husband, Danny, and their two other children, Ashley and Derrick, are united in the goal to save the girls’ lives, but will they be prepared when Dr. Phil makes them all take a hard look at themselves? Find out why Dr. Phil says the whole family is sick. Will the twins agree to treatment? And what will happen to their children? Don’t miss this shocking story!

programme.title: Rid Your Life Of The Rescue Trap
programme.desc: Are we protecting kids or weakening them? Dr. Phil examines how over-rescuing children may be fueling anxiety, entitlement, and fragility, then turns the mirror on adults trapped by the same excuses, avoidance, and old life scripts.

programme.title: The Groomers
programme.desc: With their hands full grooming dogs and their phones ringing nonstop, the new owners of an established dog-grooming business turn to HighLevel and Dr. Phil for help attracting new customers and keeping their growing business on track.

programme.title: Is Gold Right for You?
programme.desc: With so much uncertainty surrounding oil, the economy, inflation, and retirement planning, how do you know if gold is right for you?

programme.title: Race to the Altar
programme.desc: Dr. Phil’s guests say they’re not getting any younger, and the race is on to say “I do.” Sharon is 48 and says her biological clock is ticking away. She recently got engaged to a man whom she acknowledges is flawed, and she says her family doesn’t approve of her husband-to-be. Can she get them to accept her beau before they walk down the aisle, or do her relatives have a reason to be concerned? Then, Shea from the reality show Southern Belles: Louisville says that as she was planning her big day, she learned that her fiancé allegedly cheated. Now that the wedding is off, can Shea pick up the pieces and move on? Plus, a dating coach explains the biggest dating mistakes women make.

programme.title: Chelsea Refuses to Grow Up
programme.desc: Is it asking too much for your 20-something child to make his or her own money and live independently? Barbara says her daughter, Chelsea, needs to grow up! She says she’s given her daughter nothing but the best, and all she has to show for it is a lying child who won’t speak to her. Chelsea says she can’t live up to her mom’s “rich bitch” expectations and just wants to be left alone. Mother and daughter see each other on the Dr. Phil stage for the first time in seven months, and sparks fly! Is Barbara surprised to learn the secret Chelsea reveals? Then, Chelsea’s grandmother isn’t immune to her granddaughter’s conniving ways. Learn why she feels used. And, Barbara says Chelsea has spent thousands of dollars of her family’s money, and anytime she earns her own, she spends it and doesn’t pay her family back. Dr. Phil conducts an experiment to see what the young woman will do with $500. You may be surprised by the results!

programme.title: Brat Ban
programme.desc: Children kicked off flights, prohibited from eating in restaurants and banned from vacation hot spots -- from parents to patrons, today’s guests all have an opinion about what’s being called the “brat ban” policies that many places are adopting that enforce kid-free zones. Dr. Phil's first guest, Serita, took her 14-month-old son to her local public library, but when the boy became too noisy, Serita was not only told to leave -- she was arrested! Learn how the incident escalated and got both mother and son banned. Then, it made front page headlines when a shopper slapped a stranger’s toddler at Walmart. The man at the center of the controversy speaks publicly for the first time about the incident that landed him in jail. And, Pittsburgh restaurant owner Mike Vuick caused an uproar from angry parents when he banned children under 6 from his dining room. What caused Mike to impose the ban, and has business suffered or thrived as a result? Plus, is banning kids more about banning bad pare

programme.title: Parenting Disasters: Extreme Excuses
programme.desc: Darcy says that her sister, Jennifer’s, home is in a state of complete chaos. She says Jennifer and her husband, Ralph, have no rules, their kitchen is bare, the electricity is often shut off, and they put their needs ahead of those of their four children -- who are acting out as a result. Darcy says her nephews, 8 and 10, smoke marijuana, play with weapons and recently started a local forest fire -- and that the 10-year-old once wrote a note asking for someone to kill him in his sleep. She says her 12-year-old niece was recently called to truancy court, and her 16-year-old niece is having unprotected sex in the home with her older, live-in boyfriend. Ralph concedes that he’s struggling to provide for his family financially and has made mistakes as a parent, but says Jennifer is to blame, claiming she’s checked out as a mother. Jennifer admits she’s detached from her family, struggles with depression and has trouble maintaining the household. With this family in dire need of a resoluti

programme.title: Pregnant At 11
programme.desc: At just 11 years old, Hope became pregnant with her then 13-year-old boyfriend, Bailey’s, child — Ashlynn, now 7 months old. Dr. Phil talks to the children’s parents: How did this happen? Plus, hear from Hope and Bailey. Do they want custody of Ashlynn, who is currently being cared for by Hope's aunt? What is their relationship now — and are they at risk for having another baby? Then, Dr. Phil weighs in. What advice does he have for the families moving forward?

programme.title: Country Music Duo, Maddie & Tae: Don’t Call It a Break-Up
programme.desc: Multi-platinum Country music duo, Maddie and Tae discuss their recent announcement that that Tae would putting her career on hold to focus on motherhood, and Maddie, for the first time since she was a teenager, would be exploring a solo career.

programme.desc: Gary Brecka spent 20 years predicting lifespans for the insurance industry. Now he's reading Dr. Phil's real lab results live and what he finds could change the way millions of Americans think about their own health.

programme.title: A Mother Murders Her 3 Children: The Fathers Speak
programme.desc: In a small Oklahoma community, a mother shot and killed her three children before turning the gun on herself. Two of the children’s fathers speak out about what they believe drove their ex to commit the most unthinkable crime.

programme.title: My Mate’s Not Hot Enough
programme.desc: How much should looking good factor into your relationship? Today’s guests say appearance matters, and their mate is not up to their standards! Sandi says after six years of marriage, she misses her husband, Otto’s, six-pack. He says working -- not working out -- is a priority for him, and nothing will satisfy his wife, who rates herself a 20 out of 10. But the couple does agree on one thing: whatever Sandi wants, Sandi gets. Will Otto agree to hit the gym? Then, Dawn worked hard to shed 150 pounds, and when the new svelte Dawn met Paul, sparks flew! He thought she was hot -- until she undressed. What is she hiding? Plus, discover why Dr. Phil wrestles with his decision to help Dawn and Paul. And, Cynthia says she’s embarrassed by her boyfriend’s outdated wardrobe, and refuses to be seen with him in public! Can a professional makeover change her opinion?

programme.title: Worst Husbands In America?
programme.desc: From accusations of cheating to criticizing their clothing and secret DNA tests -- these wives say their husbands could be the worst in America! Brian and Nicole recently celebrated their first wedding anniversary, but the newlyweds say there is already trouble in paradise. Nicole says that Brian is so controlling, that he must know her whereabouts at all times and will call her up to 25 times in a row to make sure she’s not cheating. Brian admits he doesn’t trust Nicole, and simply wants her to respect him. Growing frustrated, the couple says unless they come to a compromise, they are prepared to part ways. What does Dr. Phil say they must do to get their marriage back on track? Then, Shaunna says she feels like a prisoner in her own home. She says her husband terrifies her and controls every aspect of her life, from how she dresses and styles her hair, to when she can leave the house and whom and what she can look at in public. Aaron says he's just trying to help his wife, but then w

programme.title: Over The Top Moms
programme.desc: A mom is supposed to love and nurture her children, but what if she's too involved? Reed, 33, says his mother, Margaret, is so meddling, manipulative and controlling that the day she dies will be a cause for celebration, not mourning. He claims she uses bribes to control his every move, including offering him $20,000 to divorce his first wife. Margaret admits that she can be pushy and difficult but says she just wants to see her son succeed in life. Is she really setting him up for failure? Does Reed really want to man-up and break free from his mother's grasp? And, is Margaret willing to let him go? Then, 35-year-old Anthony, star of the new TLC reality show Mama's Boys of the Bronx, says he sees nothing wrong with living at home and letting his mom, Patti, wait on him hand and foot. Why does she say she blames herself for what happened? And, hear from Amanda’s parents, Juliet and Timothy, who say they just want their daughter to move on. When Dr. Phil gives Amanda a harsh dose of reality, will she see the situation for what it is? Hector was convicted of sexual assault of a child and is now serving up to 30 years in prison. Seri is raising their daughter and has a new boyfriend, Will, but she admits that she would consider taking Hector back, if given the opportunity. programme.title: The Palm Beach Learjet Crash: What Went Wrong?
programme.desc: Nine people died in a Learjet 60 crash in Palm Beach. Dr. Phil and aviation expert Harold Katinszky examine flight data, weather, and air traffic control communications to uncover what may have caused the tragedy and separate facts from speculation.

programme.title: Pure Blue Fish
programme.desc: Imagine eating the most delicious, ocean-fresh yellowtail, bluefish, or redfish — that came from the desert, not the ocean. In this episode, Dr. Phil meets the brains behind Pure Blue Fish — an innovative aquaculture company raising sushi-grade ocean fish hours from the nearest ocean. It's as sustainable as it is delicious.

programme.title: Don't Let It Happen to You
programme.desc: The Doctors are joined by home improvement guru and safety expert, Eric Stromer, to share important tips about home, flood and fire safety. Learn what to do if you find yourself in a dangerous situation. And, kitchen safety rules to live by.

programme.title: Top F-Words Everyone Fears
programme.desc: Fainting, falling, flu, fibroids and fat … F-words can pack a punch. Fret not! See a new solution for uterine fibroids and get the facts about fainting. And, reduce the risk of falls with Tai Chi exercises!

programme.title: Complicated Love
programme.desc: Craig and Cherie say the last half of their 16-year marriage has been anything but happily-ever-after. Cherie says Craig is chauvinistic, verbally abusive and demands sex, which she admits she only gives him about three to four times a year. Craig says Cherie withholds sex to control him, and as a result, he has become a slave to his anger. Cherie fears the tension in their household is taking a toll on their 11-year-old daughter, who is often caught in the crossfire of their fighting. Dr. Phil challenges the couple to a communication test. Can they heal their wounds and rekindle their romance? Then, meet the couple who inspired the movie, The Vow. Shortly after Kim and Krickitt Carpenter were married, a terrible car crash changed everything. Krickitt lay in a coma for weeks, and awoke with no recognition of her husband. The couple shares their inspiring, though oftentimes heartbreaking, journey of falling in love all over again. How did they find their way back to each other? And what

programme.title: Mother-In-Law Mayhem
programme.desc: Robert says his mom, Kathy, calls him and his wife 20 to 30 times a day, and if they don't answer, will leave verbally-abusive voicemails and go to any length to get a response -- and it's ruining his marriage. Can Dr. Phil help this family establish healthy boundaries?

programme.title: My Fiancée vs. My Mom
programme.desc: Christian says he is stuck between two women fighting over him: his fiancée, Beth, and his mom, Carol. Beth says her future mother-in-law is meddling, constantly berates her and is trying to destroy her relationship -- and if she doesn’t butt out, Beth says she’ll be forced to end her relationship with Christian. How did the bad blood begin? Carol admits she doesn’t trust Beth and even hired a private investigator to spy on her. Why doesn’t she approve of Beth? And, what did the private investigator discover? Christian, who says he once had a great relationship with his mother, says he and Beth have canceled their wedding twice, in part due to his mother’s behavior. Is he prepared to choose between the two women in his life? And, will Carol ever accept Beth? Don’t miss Dr. Phil’s advice for this troubled family. Can they reach a resolution?

programme.title: Falsely Accused Of Being A Deadbeat Mom
programme.desc: Jared says his ex-wife, Chandra, is a deadbeat mom who has failed to pay her court-ordered child support in the last six months. He also accuses Chandra’s current husband, Jason, of physical abuse toward his two children when they’re in his care -- a claim Jason adamantly denies. Chandra accuses Jared of emotionally abusing her since their divorce five years ago, and she claims he’s determined to ruin her life with her new husband. Is Jared a concerned parent, or a bitter ex with an ulterior motive? And, with their children caught in the crossfire, can these exes stop pointing fingers and learn how to peacefully co-parent? Plus, why hasn’t Chandra paid child support? Then, don’t miss Dr. Phil’s tips on how to effectively co-parent with your ex!

programme.title: Is Mom Leading a Secret Life, or Are These Daughters Caught Up in Drama?
programme.desc: Brandy, 24, and Jacki, 27, say they believe their mother, Kimberly, is leading an X-rated secret sex life, while maintaining the façade of a happy marriage of 29 years to their stepfather. Kimberly says her daughters are stirring up drama with half-truths and misinformation and need to butt out of her business. Can Dr. Phil get to the truth — and help put this family back together?

programme.title: A Mother Murders Her 3 Children: The Fathers Speak
programme.desc: In a small Oklahoma community, a mother shot and killed her three children before turning the gun on herself. Two of the children’s fathers speak out about what they believe drove their ex to commit the most unthinkable crime.

programme.title: When the System Looks Away, Children Die
programme.desc: Two mothers warned the system their children were in danger. The system didn't listen. Now they're changing the laws that failed them. One state at a time.

programme.title: The Algae Effect
programme.desc: Who knew that algae may be the world’s greatest superfood? Dr. Phil uncovers the benefits of algae, why it may be one of the most nutrient-dense foods on the planet, and how to easily incorporate it into your diet.

programme.title: Spray Tanned Toddlers
programme.desc: The Doctors discusses the wackiest health headlines! Hilarious photos of toddlers in a fake tan mess and how to safely clean up a bad tan! Which state has the most psychopaths? The best beauty buys all for under $10! The Doctors diagnoses your toilet dilemmas in a segment called, “What The Flush!” Instant treatment to reverse tremors?

programme.title: Exclusive: In Utero Heart Surgery
programme.desc: In a The Doctors exclusive, see how a team of Doctors repaired one baby’s heart, in utero! The groundbreaking technique that allows surgeons to fix fetal heart defects inside the womb! Plus, actress and comedian Jenifer Lewis opens up her bipolar disorder and the unlikely cure that has helped her find peace! Then, American Idol alum Bucky Covington shares a heartwarming update on his daughter’s health. The simple tips that can calm you during a panic attack! And, the sweet treat that can really slash your stroke risk.

programme.title: A MOTHER MISSING, A STEPFATHER ACCUSED PT.1
programme.desc: Shelbie’s mother, Carie, disappeared on Dec. 2, 2014, and she says she believes her stepfather, Ed, or Ed’s daughter, Lauren, had something to do with it. Ed claims Carie was a drunk who spiraled out of control, using drugs and attempting suicide in the weeks before her disappearance and left their home voluntarily. Dr. Phil delves into what made a 48-year-old mother walk out of the house without car keys, wallet, phone or coat on a cold December night!

programme.title: Tethered Hearts
programme.desc: Token is a charismatic club owner who's inherited his father's iconic jazz club, and uses it at a sanctuary for the broken and struggling artists. When he meets Pearl, a recovering addict, he becomes embroiled in fight to keep his club alive from a shady music executive.

programme.title: Homeboys
programme.desc: Two young men grew up together with childhood goals. They graduated college and tried to begin their professional lives. When one of the homeboys decided to take matters into his own hands. programme.title: Love and Deceit 2
programme.desc: Carolyn, a successful businesswoman moves to a new town in hopes of laying down some roots after her divorce. She joins a local women's group ran by Beverly Jordan a respected therapist to help process her emotions. When in reality, she's there to rekindle an old flame with a former lover, who happens to be Beverly's husband.

programme.title: The Good Sister
programme.desc: Raven moves in with her sister Devin and her husband in Atlanta, where she begins to dig her claws into Devin's life and home, and seducing her husband. Devin must make a choice that could be deadly to save her own life and happiness.

programme.title: The Special Affect
programme.desc: Expecting mother & artist, Destiny, spirals after a tragic loss. Her loving husband helps her cope, but a bad trip and missed meds spark disturbing memories. With the help of her best friend, Destiny uncovers a horrifying truth about her past.

programme.title: Deadly Housewife
programme.desc: Florence is a housewife who yearns for something new and exciting in her love life. Things turn deadly real quick when she doesn't get what she wants.

programme.title: The Princess Killers
programme.desc: Two friends take a chance to change their lives and become partners in the world of crime, and build reputations as strong, no nonsense, business women. They soon discover it?s lonely at the top, when their enemies close in on them, while maintaining their own friendship.

programme.title: When it Rains
programme.desc: While Todd is away at Graduate school to better his family, his wife Janice is back home taking care of her sick mother. The long distance marriage takes a toll on the two. When Todd ends up encountering a woman named Sharon at a bar, sparks fly.

programme.title: Quiet as Kept
programme.desc: Jay is unlawfully detained. His ex-girlfriend returns, and his business partners work to clear his name. Meanwhile, a crooked cop is under suspicion for murder, and connections are made between him and Jay. Torn between duty and loyalty, Detective Johnson is caught in the middle. As the prosecution struggles, Jay and his business partners work to exist the dangerous world cleanly.

programme.title: Untangled Mirror
programme.desc: J. Nicole is a determined mother, entrepreneur, and hairstylist fighting to balance her personal and professional worlds while navigating love, family, and the weight of false perceptions. By day, she runs her salon with pride, presenting herself as confident and successful. But behind closed doors, she faces child custody battles, tense encounters with her ex, and a controlling new partner.

programme.title: Gutta Mamis
programme.desc: Shinette and Tierra have always vowed to ride-or-die for one another. So when opportunity knocks, it's time to do what they do best - get to the bag! It was supposed to go down like all of the others, except this time, they walk away from the scene with a body on their hands. As long as Tierra sticks to the script and doesn't utter a word, there's nothing to worry about.

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: Former Navy SEAL Ares Sterling, a family man with a dark past, lives peacefully until his wife Lisa is kidnapped after a home invasion. Desperate, Ares seeks help from his estranged father, King, a crime boss he blames for his tragic childhood. Ares revisits the shadows of his past, becoming ruthless to save Lisa and protect his daughter from similar loss, uncovering shocking secrets along the way.

programme.title: Bad Girl Revelation
programme.desc: Bora tries to untie herself from her sister's decision while trying to get out of the drug game with her social media profession. Mob boss, Ivan, makes a mistake and sends money electronically for a hit and tries to get his refund.

programme.title: Angel and Demon
programme.desc: When sheltered college student Angel, the daughter of the police chief, falls for Romelle "Demon" Montez, the ruthless leader of the South Side Mobb, they instantly become star-crossed lovers. Their toxic romance spirals into a world of gang violence and threatens Angel's once promising future.

As DEA Agent Harrison closes in, Jay battles his past to protect Tony. A dangerous deal with Marco, escalates the chaos, leading to overdose and murder plots. Now, Tony faces a stark choice: witness or prison.

Deandre seeks help to recover his losses. Both are involved in secret affairs, concealing crucial information from their partners, leading to tragic consequences.

programme.title: Holy Hip Hop
programme.desc: Fasten your seatbelt and prepare to experience the explosive world of Spiritually-Enlightening Holy Hip Hop Ministry, Music and Entertainment Glorifying GOD!!!

programme.desc: This is the second excerpt in the story of Keenan Robinson, a recent college graduate struggling to keep his head above water and finding his true calling in life. Keenan takes his younger foster brother Marvin under his wing to help guide him to a better walk with GOD. They face many life challenges and obstacles together including life and death decisions.

programme.title: Prodigal Husband
programme.desc: Ex-NFL player Kedar Ellis is depressed about his future after a career ending injury. His loyal wife Lydia encourages him to find another way to make a living. Unbeknownst to him he is tempted, loses faith and leaves. Left alone to run the household, Lydia has to keep the family afloat, but first, she must find faith, strength and forgiveness!

programme.desc: PREACHING TO THE PASTOR is a musical comedy about the controversy going on at High and Mighty Missionary Baptist Church. The Pastor has a dark secret that may cost him his title and his ministry. In the end, everyone needs to be preached to, including the Pastor.

programme.title: Pearl
programme.desc: Getting out of rehab, losing his girlfriend, and the death of his mother; life has been rough for Travis. Determined to fix his life, Travis gets sober. That is until he meets, Pearl, a girl more dangerous than his addictions.

programme.desc: College student, Quan, is presented with an opportunity too good to turn down. When she lets her sister, Bree, in on the deal, she takes it to the next level. Soon Quan realizes they both are in too deep, and is faced with the consequences.

programme.desc: A rip-roaring saga of runaway ambition stars Chicago's own Simeon Henderson ("Chicago PD", "Empire") as an arrogant would-be news anchor whose after-word dalliance with the wrong alluring intern sets off a chain of fateful events. Director Kyle Miller brings a grand sense of melodrama to this story of broken faith and the quest for forgiveness.

Shortly after, Desire' sees Will's cousin Ike shoot someone and becomes a witness in the investigation. Five years later after Ike has left town, and Will's name has been cleared, Desire reveals a shocking secret.

Yet, her numbers aren't improving, and she's on the verge of being released from her contract. Her manager, suggests she returns to Atlanta and meet with a power house music producer to give her a refresh on her sound. However, she's forced to stay with and reunite with her mother, and address the trauma of her childhood.

programme.desc: Crystal is joined by local comedian Bryson Brown in Austin, Texas where they head down to the historic and celebrated Victory Grill. A local staple that hosted the likes of Billie Holiday and James Brown. Crystal partakes in local history and delicious shrimp and grits for this modern spin on brunch. Then, Crystal and Bryson bring the laughs with a special performance in Austin.

programme.title: Beautifully Insecure
programme.desc: Imagine falling in love with someone but not being able to love yourself. Leanna was diagnosed with Alopecia at age 7 and by 9 years of age all of her hair was gone. By her early 20's her insecurities had such a grip on her heart that she became a master of hiding her hair loss. It wasn't until she met Terrence, the love of her life, that she felt she couldn't hide it any longer. As their love grew, the pressure to tell Terrence about her hair loss did also.

programme.title: Class Dismissed
programme.desc: When an unemployed actress finds herself broke and sleeping on her best friend's couch, she is forced to get a job as a substitute teacher working with one student. She soon realizes that it takes real super powers to deal with this "classroom terror" and dysfunctional staff.

programme.title: Incomplete
programme.desc: Incomplete is a captivating story of one woman's longing to complete her family through love and desire but unearths an elusive weave of deception. It's a riveting tale of trust, betrayal and the fine lines that divides when secrets are hidden and shared with strangers.

programme.desc: From the castle of the real Count Dracula to the Super City of Adolf Hitler, history is full of temples, fortresses, lost civilizations, and secret worlds that have been left behind by the passage of time. But a team of field investigators and engineering experts went out into the world in search of clues about these great feats of engineering, technology, and culture in order to bring them back to life with modern-day graphic technology.

programme.title: Convenience Store Chaos
programme.desc: With supply chain shortages, prices skyrocketing and?more shoplifting than ever before, positive customer relations are nearly impossible.?A&E?s new series CUSTOMER WARS?spotlights the conflicts that arise when disgruntled and irrational customers come face to face with the employees doing their best to take care of their needs. From fiery exchanges at the fast-food drive thru, to loss-prevention brawls this series proves once and for all that?"The customer is always right"?is the exception rather than the rule.

programme.title: There Goes The Neighborhood
programme.desc: With a record number of Americans trading city life for homes in the suburbs, relationships between neighbors are being put to the test. Each half-hour episode of "Neighborhood Wars" takes viewers into the homes and backyards of neighbors across the country with some of the most unexpected and emotionally charged events caught on camera. Featuring footage from cell phones, drones, home security cameras and more, the series showcases the kindness and conflict between real-life neighbors throughout the US.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: After Norwegian researchers discover an alien ship buried in the ice, paleontologist Kate Lloyd (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) joins the team at the isolated Arctic outpost to investigate. She finds an organism that appears to have perished in the crash eons ago but, in fact, is about to awake. Freed from its icy prison, the insidious life-form goes on the attack. Paranoia spreads like wildfire among the crew as they fight to survive against a creature that assumes the shapes of its victims.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: The Purge
programme.desc: In an America ravaged by crime and overcrowded prisons, the government sanctions an annual 12-hour period during which all criminal activity -- including murder -- is legal. James Sandin and his family face the ultimate test when an intruder drags the vicious outside world into their home. James, Mary and their two children struggle to survive the night while trying not to turn into monsters like the ones they are striving to avoid.

programme.title: The Purge: Election Year
programme.desc: As a young woman, Sen. Charlie Roan survived the annual night of lawlessness that took the lives of her family members. As a presidential candidate, Roan is determined to end the yearly tradition of bloodlust once and for all. When her opponents hatch a deadly scheme, the senator finds herself trapped on the streets of Washington, D.C., just as the latest Purge gets underway. Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: The Purge
programme.desc: In an America ravaged by crime and overcrowded prisons, the government sanctions an annual 12-hour period during which all criminal activity -- including murder -- is legal. James Sandin and his family face the ultimate test when an intruder drags the vicious outside world into their home. James, Mary and their two children struggle to survive the night while trying not to turn into monsters like the ones they are striving to avoid.

programme.title: The Purge: Election Year
programme.desc: As a young woman, Sen. Charlie Roan survived the annual night of lawlessness that took the lives of her family members. As a presidential candidate, Roan is determined to end the yearly tradition of bloodlust once and for all. When her opponents hatch a deadly scheme, the senator finds herself trapped on the streets of Washington, D.C., just as the latest Purge gets underway. Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: After Norwegian researchers discover an alien ship buried in the ice, paleontologist Kate Lloyd (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) joins the team at the isolated Arctic outpost to investigate. She finds an organism that appears to have perished in the crash eons ago but, in fact, is about to awake. Freed from its icy prison, the insidious life-form goes on the attack. Paranoia spreads like wildfire among the crew as they fight to survive against a creature that assumes the shapes of its victims.

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: The Kingdom
programme.desc: Charged with the most important assignment of his career, federal agent Ron Fleury has one week to assemble a team, infiltrate and destroy a terrorist cell based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

Third Floor Pigu is a tense supernatural thriller where love, fear, and survival collide, proving that unimaginable horror can exist

programme.title: The Pretty Ones Are The Loneliest
programme.desc: Emem is a 37-year old woman in a rocky marriage not helped by the fact that her teenage son from a previous relationship, Bassey, always gets in trouble, drawing the angst of his stepfather Tamuno. Emem decides to take him to stay with her Widower Father; Dr. Udoh who had retired and has been living in his country home since the death pf his wife. Bassey who has always searched for a place to belong finds it in his Grandfather's home. They form a bond which transcends that of relatives and he has to help his Grandfather who has a love trouble of his own; He is smitten by a nurse he meets on one of his walks but he has never been with another woman aside his late wife who he had been married to for over 53 years. Emem is still dealing with her crumbling marriage and is tempted when a wild painter she interviews for her magazine falls in love with her. Bassey also somehow gets entangled with an emotionally unavailable girl and all three are trying to overcome their loneliness.

programme.title: Deranged
programme.desc: Widower Dominic questions his daughter Julie about the man responsible for the baby she is carrying but she seems not to remember. Dominic disown Julie with a hard slap and chases her away from home. Unsure, Julie rushes to Allan whom he finds in a hideout playing cards with his gang friends. Allan blasts her straight away, denying to be the father of the baby which confuses Julie furthermore. Unsure again, Julie meets her last resort Wilbur (whom she had sex with a few months back), in a church corridor who also does the same as Allan. But something happens. Wilbur's Wife Emily catches them unaware and when she tries to kill Julie with a knife, Wilbur shields Julie who narrowly escapes. Jealously Emily pierces herself to death. Julie wonders off. Left with no option, she takes poison from an abandoned house where a Psychotic guy Tembo leaves. One hour later, Tembo comes back and finds Julie nearly dying. He rushes her to a nearby clinic, where doctors find out that she had aborted the baby. Later Tembo takes Julie with him to another abandoned warehouse. When Dominic's love for his daughter Julie resurfaces, he starts looking for her but it’s too late. When he later learns that Julie is completely missing, he employs officer Toby and Nita to find her. Tory and Nita brutally arrest Allan together with his new girlfriend and question them about Julies' whereabouts. Allan denies everything, which makes Toby keep both them in custody. Dominic announces on radio and TVs promising to give 800 dollars to whoever find Julie. He also makes a poster that circulate around with Julie's Photo, names, and age. Secretly, Julie hopelessly leaves with Tembo and Nine moths later she delivers a baby at death's door, whom they named "Tine".One day when Tembo goes to steal food for breastfeeding Julie, he is caught and beaten black and blue. He does not come back to Julie anymore, which makes Julie wander off with her baby Tine. She leaves Tine with Eric who once dated her when she was at Tembo's place and goes to her father. Happily, Dominic welcomes and forgives Julie. But shortly, mysteriously Tembo kidnap Julie from the borehole to his new scrappy shelter. He brutally demands Julie for his child Tine but Julie lies to him that Tine died. This is where Emily's Ghost comes in and in revenge, tells Tembo the truth that Julie is lying. Tembo cruelly whips Julie for this.

programme.title: Kapana
programme.desc: George, insurance broker, openly gay in a country where sodomy is still a crime, meets Simeon in a bar. The following day, they accidently meet again at Simeon's work place. Simeon is a Kapana seller (kapana is the local name for barbecued meet). George realises Simeon is in the closet. They keep seeing each other at the market. George then discovers that Simeon also plays soccer and is in the same team as his brother. They start meeting regularly. Simeon even accidentally meets George's family. Everything seems to go well, until Simeon realises George is on ARV. He feels betrayed George has never shared his status before and they break up. While Simeon drinks and tries one night stand with other guys, George gets depressed. Windhoek being a small city, they eventually meet again. In the end Simeon's sister, a nurse, help him understand that he can be with someone who is HIV positive and takes his ARV. Simeon goes back to George, apologising for his behaviour.

The Fondom is torn apart as some elders want an amendment of the culture while others stick to the old ways for their selfish reasons. The Fon chooses to go the extra mile of saving his son which costs him his life. The struggle of inheritance becomes the next big worry while the prince continues working extremely hard in bringing health to his people while secrets unfold

programme.title: The Rude Awakening
programme.desc: What if Christ paid another visit to earthâ€¦, would he think we were worth dying for? Give the man, power of any kind, and his true character emerges; in the case of President Bonner, his greedy intuition, has no break, and no conscience in amassing wealth by whatever means necessary until he meets a rude awakening in supper natural phenomena in Christ, who appeared to him, to change the narratives, even as his bad side resists, but good always wins.

programme.title: The Herbert Macaulay Affair
programme.desc: The Herbert Macaulay Affair is a story that follows Young Herbert who returns from England and begins the opposition to the colonial government In 1898, Herbert is done with his scholarship training and becomes the first Engineer and Surveyor in the colony. Upon his return he is employed by the Colonial Government in Lagos He faces a lot of discrimination and watches it being done to fellow Lagosians. Annoyed by the constant marginalization, Herbert quits his job with the colonial government and starts a long opposition to them. He meets a beautiful woman Caroline Pratt who he falls madly in love with and unfortunately loses her to death during childbirth. Herbert is devastated and when he emerges from that darkness he delves more into fighting for independence. Our film catalogues a series of historical events which ends with him going to England to represent the Oba at the Privy council despite the colonial government doing everything to stop him. Car chases, Intrigues, schemes, nationalism and family are all part of this intense 90 minutes movie William Benson plays the Title character Herbert Macaulay. A veteran actor of many theatrical performances. He is well-beloved by a lot of Nigerians mostly because of his role as General Ape in the critically-acclaimed primetime drama Ajoche. He has garnered a cult following and delivers an Oscar-worthy performance in our film The Herbert Macaulay Affair

programme.title: First Born
programme.desc: A grade six boy Langcer Divine (Frubi Rollins) is caught in a web of abuse and neglect by his school teachers and peers because of his dullness. He is refused to be registered as an internal candidate for the Common Entrance Examination, as the school wishes to uphold its reputation of academic excellence. Back at home, Divine being the lone child to his parents, goes through emotional torture as they scold at him at every given opportunity. In the midst of his pain and dark clouds, his class teacher Mr. Pangala Nicodemus (Tampy Livinus) comes to his rescue by unraveling a biblical revelation 'Exodus 13:2'. It is discovered that Divine as a first born to his parents, inherited a curse. Could this have been the cause of his dullness or was he a victim of stigmatization and hate by a school system that cares for bright pupils and its reputation to the detriment of slow learners?

programme.title: Dice
programme.desc: Dice tells the story of AJ, a young, nerdy and smart stockbroker who moved to Lagos from London at the age of 10. He has been working at Abubakar Investments for several years and has become very successful at closing sales deals and making 'little' commission from them. AJ is perceived to have a dual personality; one he exhibits at work as a young naÃ¯ve and nerdy individual and the other outside work as an extrovert. At work, his colleagues Emeka and Bala often throw shade at him and bully him because they find him extremely boring and simple. They also find him slow because of his inability to stand up for himself and demand his rightful 3% Commission. Unknown to them AJ has a good life outside of work as he often hangs out at the club with his best friend Segun, both are serial ladies and men. Emeka & Bala are aware that Mr. Abubakar constantly cheats him off his commission, but are unaware that he has taken matters into his own hands by using clients' funds to engage in side hustles beneficial to him. This side hustling however gets him in trouble when he loses a client's money and has to borrow money from a gangster which he fails to pay back on time. His external deals also lead to the company being investigated by EFFD as several holes have been spotted in the company's financials. Having had bad luck with ladies in the past, AJ finally finds love in the weirdest place when he meets Amaka and finds himself having to fight for the woman of his dreams who he also puts in danger.

programme.title: Peremende
programme.desc: To save her dying son, Latifa sells an organ and enters a deadly trafficking ring run by a compromised surgeon and a crime boss. Trapped in a system that exploits the poor, a single mistake forces her to decide between silence or destroying the machine that profits from her poverty.

programme.title: Made In Heaven
programme.desc: Richard is a nerdy and awkward romantic, consistently unlucky in love. He finds himself in a bad situation which leads to a tragic end, but then he is given a second chance at life to find love, with a very limited time.

programme.title: A Beautiful Day To Die (Une Bonne Journee Pour Mourir)
programme.desc: After celebrating Sasha's birthday with bottles of beers and whiskies, her three friends, Johnn, Tom, and Sam decide to take her to a nearby town for more celebrations but on their way, their car hits and kills a passerby on a lonesome road. They decide to hide the crime as Johnny, the governor's son argues that it will negatively influence his father's political career. However, on their way to bury the corpse, their car is stopped by a police officer and as the officer discovers the corpse, he is shot dead by Johnny but unfortunately during the clash, the officers shoots at Sam. To cover up this new crime three other people will die.

programme.title: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Neema, a successful accountant haunted by her past, seeks her missing sister Tabu with relentless determination, guided by a witch doctor. Her journey is fraught with trials—getting lost in a mystical forest, surviving a bus fire, and encountering Sabri, a teacher, and Farida, a bar owner who alternates between ally and adversary. In a remote village, Neema faces moral dilemmas and violent confrontations, uncovering shocking truths about Tabu’s abusive husband Frank. Their reunion is bittersweet as Tabu refuses to leave Frank. After he brutally attacks Tabu, Neema exacts revenge in a deadly showdown, leaving her broken and bleeding on a bridge. Themes of family loyalty, sacrifice, and violence paint a vivid picture of resilience and despair.

programme.title: Breaking with Customs
programme.desc: Tyranny chief with his guards storms Nono’s home for her daughter Nsanji whom the chief wants to be his fourth wife as tradition puts it. But Nsanji refuses because she loves Mpaka, her long-time fiancé. When the Chief leaves, Nono beats Nsanji badly until she accepts to marry the Chief. When the inflexible Mpaka gets to know about it, he launches war against the chief although his Father warns him not to defy tradition. Shortly, Mpaka helps Nsanji escape from the palace. Quickly, the Chief launches a deadly hunt for them, and soldiers search the whole village until they capture them one by one. While on a punishment podium, whipped Mpaka swears never to dump Nsanji and Nsanji does the same.

programme.title: Helping Chalo
programme.desc: Justina sets up a cooperative centre that sells safer nicotine products but must face a local cigarette seller and a secret smoker who uses money to entice people to stop smoking instead of providing long lasting solutions to help people quit smoking completely.

programme.title: Nalwawo
programme.desc: A story set in an affluent suburb of Kampala where Nanta Sentamu is a beautiful middle-aged woman married to Kwezi Sentamu, a man Nanta’s family consider the ultimate catch and one who can do no wrong. Nanta has dedicated her life to being the perfect wife catering to her husband’s needs in every way despite the fact their 10 year marriage is childless, with the blame solely put on Nanta’s shoulders; after all it is always the woman’s fault if a couple is childless as has been traditionally opined. Despite having a degree, Nanta married Kwezi, a man 20 years her senior, straight out of University because he had taken on the financial responsibility of her education, an arrangement Kwezi made with her father when he saw the 15-year old Nanta come visit her father at the law-firm Kwezi owned. Despite the loneliness and isolation in her marriage, Nanta has constantly been told how lucky she is that she is married to a man that can provide for her and help her family. However, Kwezi, a high-profile lawyer who is rarely seen with his wife, dates frequently and is constantly linked with multiple women, but he refuses Nanta to work or have a life outside of their home. Nanta’s failed desperate attempts to win her husband’s love and affection, her inability to conceive a child and her numerous financial obligations to her family have taken a toll on her mentally and emotionally. When her husband, Kwezi, informs Nanta that he is going away on a business trip that will take all weekend, she sees it as an opportunity to spend some time with her family only to find to stumble on Kwezi marrying her much younger sister, Kesa, in a traditional ceremony at Nanta’s family home with everyone in attendance apart from her. Nanta’s sense of betrayal and humiliation by all of those closest to her is complete when Kwezi unremorsefully informs that Kesa is pregnant with his baby. When Nanta has a very public meltdown at her parent’s home and proceeds to disrupt the ceremony, she is angrily and forcibly dragged out of the family compound by her father and is informed that she should be grateful that it was her sister that Kwezi was marrying because then they would not lose their generous benefactor. programme.desc: This story deals with aspects of the European Colonization of the African continent in a very simple but unique way. The story also suggests that, both the Black Man and the White Man worship the same Almighty God but through different mediums.

programme.title: In My Father's Village
programme.desc: Rhuveneko, 19, rides on a bus and opens a picture book, gazing at old pictures of her father. She goes back to his village to claim her inheritance, but things have changed. Zimbabwe became independent in 1980. A fierce liberation war had brought the long-awaited freedom, but the scars of this war are still felt until today. And the spoils of the war were only going to be shared with a few...

programme.title: Once Upon a Family
programme.desc: Every family has its issues, and this one is no exception. Once Upon A Family tells the story of a complicated Ghanaian family and the dark secrets they wished to hide - but all comes to light during the family reunion of a lifetime.

programme.title: Kienyeji
programme.desc: Kienyeji tells the story of two university students, Cynthia and Charlie, from conflicting Kenyan communities who fall in love and plan to marry despite their families' opposition. The narrative explores tribalism and cultural differences as their attempts to unite face challenges, including a failed ruracio due to unpaid dowry, food poisoning at a second attempt, and ultimately, divorce pressured by Charlie's father. Amid exams, financial struggles, and personal setbacks, their journey unfolds with Ohangla and Mugithi music, raising questions about love and tradition. Will love triumph, or will societal pressures prevail?

programme.title: Mono
programme.desc: "Young students arrive at the prestigious Francis Morris Morton Mission High School (Framomo) to join Form One. Their parents believe that this is the right school to turn their sons into men. As the boys discover a deep and sinister rot in the school, they try to fight for their voice, but it could cost them more than they are willing to sacrifice. Will Oliver and his friends survive Framomo?"

programme.title: Prato Frio
programme.desc: Erica, a 19-year-old young woman, lives a seemingly perfect life with her wealthy parents. But her world shatters when armed intruders break into their home and brutally murder her family. As she grieves, the truth comes to light â€” "Frozen Revenge" unfolds as a gripping psychological thriller exploring trauma, betrayal, and vengeance, set against the backdrop of modern-day Mozambique. A powerful story of a young woman who turns pain into a relentless pursuit of revenge.

programme.title: Villains in the Metropolis
programme.desc: A brilliant young medical doctor, stunningly beautiful, morphs into a heartless murderer after a positive pregnancy test, and a cheating lover.

programme.title: The Department
programme.desc: She used to live in Lagos, Nigeria and run industrial sabotage for a Nigerian conglomerate until she got married and moved to the suburbs. Now she's a bored housewife and her company wants her back for one last job. She accepts against the wishes of her husband who then decides to sabotage the project in an attempt to save their marriage.

programme.title: Strawberry Chinny
programme.desc: After a brutal breakup leaves her homeless, a 28-year-old makeup artist moves in with her childhood best friend, but their platonic bond is tested when his demanding new girlfriend enters the picture, forcing them to confront their true feelings for each other.

programme.title: The Confessor
programme.desc: Rev. Johnson a thirty-five year old priest loses his sister and only remaining family member at the hands of some armed robbers. His efforts to get the police to bring the culprits to book prove abortive, as they made no serious efforts to hunt down the criminals. Disappointed in the way the Nigerian police handled the case, he went away for a while to try to heal and returns a year later to continue his role as a priest. 3 years later, he listens to the confession of an armed robber who narrates a brutal rape and murder of a girl, five years earlier. This brought back old memories and a battle with his conscience, faith and deep seated hate still lies in his heart. After listening to the confession of the armed robber, it becomes clear that he was one of the robber's responsible for his sister's death. He decides to take the law into his own hands by finding all the men responsible for his sister's death and make them pay for their actions. This new development sends chills down the spine of members of the community, as the police and the people begin to wonder if they now have a vigilant or just a murderer.

programme.title: Soul Boy
programme.desc: Nairobi, Kenya. 14 year-old Abila lives with his parents in Kibera, one of the largest slums in East Africa. One morning the teenager discovers his father ill and delirious. Someone has stolen his soul, mumbles the father as he sits huddled in a corner. Abila is shocked and confused but wants to help his father and goes in search of a suitable cure. Supported by his friend Shiku who is the same age as him, he learns that his father has gambled his soul away in the company of a spiritual woman. The teenager doesn’t want to believe it and sets about looking for the witch. When he finally discovers her in the darkest corner of the ghetto, she gives him seven challenging tasks to save his father’s lost soul. Abila embarks on an adventurous journey which leads him right through the microcosm of his home town.

programme.title: Wheel and Deal
programme.desc: Addicted to the desire for this pleasurable life leads a retired Marine Corps to plot a scheme along with a computer genius on how to get rich regardless of those involved. A one million dollars life insurance policy is his initiative and his children;Georgia, Kelvin and Regina are his beneficiaries including his grandchildren (Ben Jr & Benita). To receive the money once he’s dead, he carries on his first plan. He and his felon partner who happens to be a genius in hijacking, infiltrate the health system, pose as the personal to Kels by creating a terminal disease that Kels (this Ex-Marie Corps) suffers from.
