programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes 2 Programa 12
programme.desc: Hoy es una noche especial, la gran final de Pequeños Gigantes ha llegado. Iniciaron siete escuadrones y sólo tres llegan a la final. Sonrisas, lágrimas y todo el talento de niños extraordinarios pero hoy solo un escuadrón será el ganador del gran trofeo.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 1
programme.desc: El espectacular programa ha comenzado y los pequeños grandes talentos se hicieron presentes en el escenario para conformar los seis escuadrones que competirán cada semana para alcanzar su sueño.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 2
programme.desc: La espectacular competencia arranca y los seis talentosos escuadrones comienzan la lucha por alcanzar sus sueños. Los capitales se enfrentan en una divertida prueba de imitación.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 3
programme.desc: Varios talentos de las temporadas anteriores de 'Pequeños Gigantes' regresan para unirse a los participantes y ayudarles en su prueba de canto. Se vive la primera eliminación del programa. Yuridia se presenta en el escenario.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 4
programme.desc: El grupo Bronco llega al escenario de ‘Pequeños Gigantes’ para cantar sus grandes éxitos. Los ‘Pequeños Gigantes’ realizan espectaculares actuaciones en la pista de baile.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 5
programme.desc: Los pequeños bailarines se enfrentan en una prueba de mambo. El cantante Christian Nodal se presenta en el escenario de ‘Pequeños Gigantes’. Albertano sorprende en el programa cantando ‘Despacito’.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 6
programme.desc: La cantante internacional Filippa Giordano se presenta en el escenario de Pequeños Gigantes. Los capitanes se enfrentan en una prueba de preguntas y respuestas. Se vive la segunda eliminación de la competencia.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 7
programme.desc: El cantante Flex se presenta en el escenario de Pequeños Gigantes. Los bailarines se enfrentan con ritmos de cumbia y merengue. Los capitanes concursan con los jueces en pruebas de habilidad y destreza.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 8
programme.desc: El cantante Ricardo Montaner se presenta en el escenario. Los capitanes se convierten en actores y compiten por un Oscarito. Se vive la última sentencia, dos escuadrones quedan en riesgo de eliminación perdiendo la oportunidad de llegar a la gran final.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 9
programme.desc: Alicia Villarreal, Lucero y La Sonora Dinamita se presentan en el escenario. Los capitanes se enfrentan en divertidos retos en ‘4 elementitos’. Los equipos viven la última eliminación y tres escuadrones llegan a la gran final.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 10
programme.desc: Los Pequeños Gigantes viven el último programa de la competencia al lado de grandes artistas como Carlos Rivera, Ha-Ash y Espinoza Paz, quienes se presentan en el escenario para cantar junto a los finalistas y conocer a los ganadores.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 1
programme.desc: Los pequeños demostrarán su gran talento en un reto de baile y canto. Verónica Castro, Miguel Bosé, Albertano y Karol Sevilla tendrán la dura tarea de seleccionar a los miembros de los escuadrones de la nueva temporada de ‘Pequeños Gigantes’.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 2
programme.desc: La batalla entre los seis escuadrones da inicio y cada punto será vital para salvarse de la sentencia. Los pequeños demostrarán su talento a través de su carisma, su voz, sus pasos de baile y sus increíbles habilidades en Cuatro Elementitos.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 3
programme.desc: Uno de los seis escuadrones dice adiós y antes de irse, Tadeo le hace una petición especial a los jueces. Los capitanes cuentan sus historias de vida de una manera muy peculiar. Los pequeños bailarines muestran sus mejores pasos en una prueba individual.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 4
programme.desc: Grandes estrellas de la música acompañan a los pequeños en el reto de canto. La bailarina argentina, Laurita Fernández, se une como jueza invitada para calificar los retos de baile. Los capitanes rinden homenaje a Verónica Castro.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 5
programme.desc: Es noche de sentencia y los cinco escuadrones darán lo mejor en el escenario. María León se une como invitada al panel de jueces. Los capitanes se enfrentan al reto de ‘Gali Dice’ para ganar un punto extra. Albertano le da una sorpresa a todos los jueces.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 6
programme.desc: Es noche de eliminación y uno de los escuadrones deja la competencia. Los pequeños cumplen el reto de canto de Miguel Bosé con sorprendentes resultados. Los capitanes se enfrentan al reto del ‘Botonera’.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 7
programme.desc: La competencia entra en su recta final y cada prueba será decisiva para los escuadrones. Yuri se une como juez invitada. Los capitanes comparten una parte de su vida con el público. Verónica Castro recibe una sorpresa de parte de su nieta.

programme.title: Pequeños Gigantes Programa 8
programme.desc: Los pequeños reciben como invitada especial a Lucero. Albertano pone a prueba la honestidad de los capitanes. Las parejas tendrán que demostrar sus habilidades en una prueba de baile improvisado.

programme.desc: Javier, un diseñador lleno de sueños y proyectos, trabaja con su novia. Juntos trabajan en un proyecto que les dará reconocimiento a su agencia de publicidad. Javier, enamorado de su Lulú, desea formalizar su compromiso.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El que es buen gallo'
programme.desc: Una joven va a una audición para una película y canta una canción que ella escribió, pero el director trata de aprovecharse de ella. El director de la película le roba la canción a la joven y la registra como suya.

programme.title: Como Dice El Dicho - 'No hay mal'
programme.desc: Patricio tiene que abandonar a su familia para ir a trabajar al Norte. Martín, su hijo se molesta pues no comprende la situación. El hermano de Patricio busca a su familia para quedarse a vivir con ellos y apoyarlos, pero sus intenciones no son buenas.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Nunca es tarde'
programme.desc: Un chico descubre que una de sus compañeras de la escuela es molestada por otras niñas y le dice que él la va a defender. La chica le cree pero cuando se da cuenta que a él le gusta la niña que la molesta queda decepcionada.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El diablo abre la puerta'
programme.desc: Un chico se vuelve adicto a fumar sin saber que eso le traerá grandes problemas con sus sueños de ser un gran jugador de fútbol, además de hacerle daño a su hermano menor, ocasionándole una grave enfermedad.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Tanto peca el que mata la vaca'

programme.title: Como Dice El Dicho - ‘Lo que mal empieza, mal acaba’

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Más vale solo'

programme.title: Como dice el dicho - 'Cada cual carga con la cruz de su parroquia'
programme.desc: Julián, un albañil, engaña a su esposa cuando tiene la oportunidad, acostumbra salir con Heráclito, su compadre, sin saber que sus intenciones son malas y que está enamorado de Estrella, su esposa.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Quien vengarse quiere'
programme.desc: Una señora es asaltada por tres hombres que la golpean en la espalda dejándola paralítica, su hijo trata de defenderla, pero también es golpeado por ellos. El joven comienza a tomar clases de kung fu para vengarse de los asaltantes.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Más vale tarde que nunca'
programme.desc: Una joven y su familia desperdician el agua, el hijo más pequeño les pide que ahorren el agua, pero no lo escuchan, por accidente su casa se incendia y no tienen agua para combatir el fuego.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Amigo en la adversidad, amigo de verdad'
programme.desc: Gloria, es la niña más inteligente de la escuela pero también es muy insegura y soporta el bullying en su escuela, un día ella conoce a Poncho, y le ayuda a salir de esta circunstancia, mejorando también la relación que tenía con su mamá.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Hijo de tigre'
programme.desc: Un hombre y su hijo se mudan a un nuevo vecindario, cuando conocen a sus vecinas tratan de seducirlas y jugar con sus sentimientos, pero después de un tiempo se dan cuenta que el amor y el respeto son lo más importante.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Las mentiras tienen las piernas cortas Parte 1'
programme.desc: Un chico se da cuenta que un hombre quiere conquistar a su mamá y le pide que se aleje de ella. Un día el hombre trata de abusar de su mamá, ella logra escapar, lo denuncia y le promete a su hijo que no volverá a mentirle.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El muerto y el arrimado'
programme.desc: Una joven sufre de violencia familiar. La joven está harta de la situación en la que vive y trata de convencer a su madre de que huyan de su casa. El destino les tendrá preparado una sorpresa.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Un clavo saca otro clavo'
programme.desc: Alondra y Julia, madre e hija, respectivamente llevan una mala relación, incluso la primera corre a su hija de la casa. Julia se reencuentra con su prima y su tío, quienes le dan asilo y juntos deben limar asperezas y conflictos.

programme.title: Como Dice El Dicho - 'Cría cuervos'
programme.desc: Jorge es un joven rebelde que no respeta a su madre. Un día se mete en problemas por culpa de su novia. Pero la vida le da una gran lección al perder a su abuela, la única persona que siempre lo apoyó incluso para que él naciera.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Amor de padre'
programme.desc: Don Tomás sufre un infarto y despierta en un hospital, el señor que lo llevó le dice que es su hijo y le reclama por abandonarlo a él y a su madre, pero Isabel desconfía del extraño e indaga sobre la presunta paternidad de su abuelo.

programme.title: Como Dice El Dicho - 'Es una locura amar'
programme.desc: Un joven esquizofrénico, golpea a su hermana y escapa de su casa. La joven descubre que su hermano tiene esquizofrenia y ella podría estar enferma también ya que su padre le confiesa que su madre era esquizofrénica y que él también lo es.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Tener miedo es de prudentes'
programme.desc: Un joven está enamorado de una chica. El joven hace de todo para que la chica le haga caso, pero ella lo rechaza. El joven se muestra celoso al ver que la chica tiene novio. El joven abusa de la chica y le destruye la vida.

programme.title: Como Dice El Dicho - 'Antes de armas tomar'
programme.desc: Humberto es agredido por uno de sus compañeros del salón, harto de la situación decide vengarse de ellos y toma la pistola de su padre para amenazar al niño que lo molesta. Uno de sus amigos le dice que no lo haga y esconde la pistola.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Árbol que crece torcido'
programme.desc: Un joven que roba y hace cosas ilícitas para demostrar su rebeldía contra su abuela y su tío, le quita la cartera a un hombre que vende drogas y se gasta todo el dinero en un regalo para su novia.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Cada oveja con su pareja'
programme.desc: Una joven trabaja duramente para poder pagar su carrera. Un joven busca conquistar a la dulce chica, pero ella no se muestra nada interesada. Un nuevo joven ayuda a la chica a recuperar sus cosas y sin pensarlo se enamora de ella.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Aunque la mona se vista de seda'
programme.desc: Una joven consume drogas porque se siente sola, su prima la descubre y trata de ayudarla. La madre de la joven decide salir de su depresión y ayudar a su hija con su adicción.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Diablo te hiciste'
programme.desc: Miriam, es una adolescente que por falta de atención de sus padres, cae en una broma pesada por internet. El padre de Miriam es aficionado a ver páginas en internet de adolescentes y encuentra las fotos de su hija en una página prohibida.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Al que no habla'
programme.desc: Una chica va caminando con un amigo de la escuela de regreso a su casa, cuando el novio de su mamá los encuentra en la calle y amenaza al chico para que se aleje de ella. Cuando llegan al departamento, el novio de la mamá intenta manosear a la chica.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'El que quiere la flor'
programme.desc: Una joven embarazada es abandonada por el padre de su hijo, su mejor amigo la consuela. Los amigos del ex novio lo golpean. La joven le confiesa que está embarazada y él le dice que la apoya para que se deshaga del niño.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - ‘El que tiene más saliva’
programme.desc: Una chica que es integrante de una banda se pelea con el vocalista porque sabe que es una mala persona, pero una de sus amigas lo defiende y comienza a tratarla mal hasta que ella decide dejar la banda.

programme.title: Como Dice el Dicho - 'Agua que no has de beber'
programme.desc: Un joven ve cambiar su vida cuando comienza un romance apresurado con una joven. Ella resulta embarazada y esto altera todos sus planes, aunque trata de apoyarla, sus vidas toman caminos diferentes.

programme.desc: Una mujer le guarda rencor a su hermana por errores del pasado, pero debido a la enfermedad de su mamá las mujeres encuentran fuerza juntas para superar los problemas.

programme.desc: Isa conoce a Mario, un chico que la hace comprender muchas cosas y seguir firme en sus decisiones y valores. Una tarde su novio y su madre se presentan en la cafetería para pedirle que regrese a Guadalajara. Isabel decide terminar con Ernesto.

programme.title: Spring of Changdeokgung Palace: A Feast of Spring Flowers <15>
programme.desc: Built during King Taejong’s reign, Changdeokgung Palace was originally constructed as a secondary palace but served as the main palace for a longer period. Its rear garden, the only palace rear garden in Korea, showcases beautiful springtime scenery.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Crafting a Thousand-Year Sound: Making the Janggu <80>
programme.desc: The janggu, an hourglass drum with different tones on each side, holds dual voices in one instrument. Shaped with wood, leather, and rope, it carries memories passed through generations. Listen to the rhythm where tradition breathes.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Tradition Shaped by Many Hands: Gat Making Master <92>
programme.desc: Finely split bamboo forms the brim, while horsehair is woven into the crown. The Brim Maker, Crown Maker, and Gat Assembler bring their skills together to complete one elegant gat. Experience the harmony of three traditional crafts.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Simple but Savory Taste: Buckwheat Noodles <11>
programme.desc: The buckwheat grain, which grows vigorously even in poor soil, is known for its strong survival traits and distinctive aroma. Enjoy the simple but savory taste of buckwheat noodles.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Iron and Flame: Forging a Traditional Cauldron <89>
programme.desc: Creating a cast iron cauldron demands fierce heat and skilled hands. As molten metal meets the mold, everyday tradition takes shape. Hear the depth of Korean casting craft in each heavy echo.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Carving Printing Blocks: Engraving Master <40>
programme.desc: A master engraver carves letters or pictures into various materials like wood, copper, and stone, continuing a tradition passed down from ancient times.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Casting a Temple Bell: Iron Casting Master <96>
programme.desc: Molten metal flows into a massive mold as a temple bell begins to take shape. Its patterns, thickness, and resonance are all carefully considered. Hear the powerful harmony of fire and iron as the bell is born.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Forging My Protector: Crafting the Ornamental Blade <83>
programme.desc: Shaping a blade begins with fire and hammer. In the forging of this small sword lies the essence of strength, rhythm, and tradition. Hear the iron sing as each strike reveals the artisan’s devotion.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Echoes of Farewell: Folk Song of Funeral Procession <94>
programme.desc: Slow footsteps and solemn voices accompany the final journey of the departed. Sung as the funeral bier is carried to the burial site, these folk songs once united communities in remembrance and farewell. Listen to the echoes that linger between life and death.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Art of Hammering: Metal Ornament Master <30>
programme.desc: Jangseok is metal ornaments attached to wooden furniture or structures to reinforce joints or to serve as locks. Enjoy observing the traditional process of making these brass ornaments, which enhance the completeness and design of wooden furniture.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Embodying Wishes in Paper: Jihwa Master <43>
programme.desc: Jihwa has been used not only in the royal court but also in family celebrations, Buddhist ceremonies, and shamanic rituals since ancient times. A Jihwa master is an artisan who cuts and decorates paper to create adornments for ceremonies.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Crafting Paper to Last a Thousand Years: Hanji Making Master <97>
programme.desc: Mulberry bark is boiled, beaten, and spread into fibers to form a sheet of hanji. Through repeated dipping and careful handling, the artisan creates paper that is both strong and soft. Experience the quiet rhythm of hanji rising from the water.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Painting with Lacquer: The Process of Color Lacquer Art <82>
programme.desc: On a lacquered surface, colored patterns are drawn by hand, layer after layer. As each coat is applied and dried, time, patience, and vision build a work of beauty. Listen as brushstrokes blend with the passage of time.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret Garden: Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace EP.2 <2>
programme.desc: Nakseonjae combines noble residence style with palace architecture, featuring unique decorative patterns that showcase late Joseon craftsmanship. Enjoy a break at the exclusive Rear Garden of Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Mystical Hidden Scenery: Jusanji Pond, Cheongsong EP.3 <11>
programme.desc: Completed in 1720, Jusanji Pond is fed by clear waters from Byeolbawi Rock and surrounded by lush forests of Juwangsan Mountain, creating a serene, otherworldly atmosphere.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Beauty of Patience: Ottchil Master <45>
programme.desc: A Ottchil Master is an artisan skilled in decorating objects and furniture surfaces beautifully with ottchil (natural varnish/lacquer) and shells. Appreciate the works filled with the dedication and patience of the Lacquerware Master.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Sound of Bamboo Forest: Chaesangjang Master <56>
programme.desc: Chaesangjang is artisans who dye thinly sliced bamboo bark in colorful hues and weave them into various geometric patterns to make baskets and other items. Let’s appreciate the process of weaving dyed bamboo strips by a master of Chaesangjang.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Traditional Winter Tea Table: Royal Confectionery Winter Table <4>
programme.desc: Sit in the warm ondol room with thick rice cakes (Duteopddeok) and sweet Gaeseong Yakgwa, and enjoy a warm cup of Sujeonggwa. Feel the warmth of winter.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Subtle Fragrance: Tea Making <12>
programme.desc: In the early morning on the slopes of Jirisan, grandmothers pick wild tea leaves among the pine trees. Experience the subtle fragrance of traditional tea making.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Carving for the Sacred: Metal Engraving Master <59>
programme.desc: Metal carving, a tradition rooted in the Bronze Age, lives on in the intricate patterns engraved onto sarira reliquaries. programme.title: The Secret Garden: Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace EP.1 <1>
programme.desc: Nakseonjae combines noble residence style with palace architecture, featuring unique decorative patterns that showcase late Joseon craftsmanship. Enjoy a break at the exclusive Rear Garden of Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Autumn Forest of the Royal Tombs: With Queen Inhyeon's Tears, SeoOReung <19>
programme.desc: Named for its five royal tombs, Seoreung in Goyang is the second-largest royal tomb cluster of the Joseon Dynasty. Explore its vast, well-preserved natural forest paths, known as "Shinrim" (Divine Forest).(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Flowering Devotion: Shoe Making Master <65>
programme.desc: Traditional Korean shoes, delicately stitched petal by petal, are more than footwear—they embody beauty, craftsmanship, and heartfelt wishes. Each step in their making reflects generations of devotion passed down through time.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Traces of Dedication and Patience: Silk Weaving <5>
programme.desc: Korea's silk weaving technology was so advanced that Koreans sent silk goods to the Tang Dynasty (China) as early as the Silla period. Silk weaving requires dedication and patience.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Carving for the Sacred: Metal Engraving Master <59>
programme.desc: Metal carving, a tradition rooted in the Bronze Age, lives on in the intricate patterns engraved onto sarira reliquaries. Each hammer strike reflects the artisan’s devotion, preserving the sacred through centuries of skill.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Blooming from Paper: Traditional Jihwa <58>
programme.desc: Cut, folded, and twisted into bloom, these paper flowers hold layers of sincerity and hope. Once adorning palaces and sacred spaces, jihwa blossoms again in the hands of devoted artisans. Let the soft rustle of paper whisper the timeless breath of tradition.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Scenery with Royal Tombs: Gwangneung <9>
programme.desc: Gwangneung Forest is a dense forest 30 times the size of Yeouido in Seoul, known for its ecological stability and species diversity. Experience the sounds and scenery of Gwangneung.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Carving Light in the Darkness: Najeonjang <15>
programme.desc: Najeonjang refers to the craft of decorating lacquerware with mother-of-pearl designs or the craftsmen who practice this skill. Appreciate the beauty of traditional Najeonjang.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Soaring Squid: Jeolla Province Ritual Food Master <72>
programme.desc: In southern Korea, a dried squid transforms into a phoenix on the ritual table. This delicate food art, rooted in care and reverence, embodies the spirit and blessing of traditional ceremonies.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Drops of Crimson Tears: Brewing Red Liquor <76>

programme.title: Drawing with Fire: Nakhwajang <20>
programme.desc: Nakhwajang is a traditional art form where pictures and letters are burned onto surfaces using a heated iron on charcoal. Appreciate the traditional Korean ink wash painting and the art of Nakhwajang.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Sound of Bamboo Forest: Chaesangjang Master <56>
programme.desc: Chaesangjang is artisans who dye thinly sliced bamboo bark in colorful hues and weave them into various geometric patterns to make baskets and other items. Let’s appreciate the process of weaving dyed bamboo strips by a master of Chaesangjang.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Creating Wind: Seocheon Fan Master <27>
programme.desc: The peacock fan is a traditional fan cherished for its luxurious and elegant appearance. Let’s follow the process of artisan making the fan, from harvesting the bamboo to preparing the materials and completing the fan.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Korea’s Representative Food Culture: Making Kimchi <32>
programme.desc: Kimchi, a representative food of Korea! Did you know that our kimchi-making culture is listed by UNESCO? Learn the tradition of making kimchi.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Masterpieces Created by Time: Ink (Meok) <51>
programme.desc: Ink (Meok) has been one of the Four Treasures of the Study (ink, paper, brush, inkstone) and a companion of scholars since ancient times. Welcome to the world of ink, masterpieces created by time(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Subtle Fragrance: Tea Making <12>

programme.title: The Last Movie Star
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds stars as an aging screen icon who gets lured into accepting an award at a rinky-dink film festival in Nashville, launching him on both a hilarious fish-out-of-water adventure and an unexpectedly poignant journey into his past.

programme.title: C'mon C'mon
programme.desc: Johnny and his young nephew forge a tenuous but transformational relationship when they are unexpectedly thrown together in this delicate and deeply moving story about the connections between adults and children, the past and the future.

programme.title: Goon
programme.desc: Not content with his job as a bouncer, Doug Glatt (Seann William Scott) dreams of a more rewarding job and gaining his parents' respect.

programme.title: 20th Century Women
programme.desc: In 1979 Santa Barbara, Calif., Dorothea Fields is a determined single mother in her mid-50s who is raising her adolescent son, Jamie, at a moment brimming with cultural change and rebellion. Dorothea enlists the help of two younger women -- Abbie, a free-spirited punk artist living as a boarder in the Fields' home and Julie, a savvy and provocative teenage neighbor -- to help with Jamie's upbringing.

programme.title: C'mon C'mon
programme.desc: Johnny and his young nephew forge a tenuous but transformational relationship when they are unexpectedly thrown together in this delicate and deeply moving story about the connections between adults and children, the past and the future.

programme.title: Best Man Dead Man
programme.desc: A bachelor party in the middle of nowhere quickly turns into a night of murder and mystery when the best man ends up with a knife in his head. Everyone is a suspect; only an eccentric private eye in town can solve the mystery.

programme.title: Hearts in Colombo
programme.desc: When Rick surprises Shanaya by flying to Sri Lanka for Christmas, meeting her eccentric family leads to chaos, wild antics, and culture clash. Can their relationship survive the ultimate holiday test in this heartwarming Sri Lankan rom-com?

programme.title: While We're Young
programme.desc: Middle-aged filmmaker Josh Srebnick (Ben Stiller) and his wife, Cornelia (Naomi Watts), are happily married, but stuck in a rut. So, when free-spirited couple Jamie (Adam Driver) and Darby (Amanda Seyfried) enter their lives, it's like a breath of fresh air -- especially for Josh, who pines for a youth he wishes he had. Soon, Josh and Cornelia are ditching friends their own age to hang out with the hipsters -- but whether the friendship can endure despite a 20-year age gap remains to be seen.

programme.title: You Hurt My Feelings
programme.desc: A novelist's (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) longstanding marriage is suddenly upended when she overhears her husband give his honest reaction to her latest book. A film about trust, lies, and the things we say to the people we love most.

programme.title: The Skeleton Twins
programme.desc: Following many years of estrangement, twins Milo (Bill Hader) and Maggie (Kristen Wiig) have an unexpected reunion after a set of near-tragedies. The situation forces them to confront how their lives became so broken. For Maggie, it means examining why she's so unhappy in a marriage to a loving husband. For Milo, it means meeting with his first love to see if their romance can reignite. Eventually, they learn that living truthfully and accepting each other is the only way to move forward.

programme.title: Employee of the Month
programme.desc: Zack (Dane Cook) and Vince (Dax Shepard) are rival co-workers at Super Club, the country's largest bulk-discount retailer, but while Vince is on the fast track at Super Club, Zack's laid-back approach to work holds him back. That all changes when a new cashier, named Amy (Jessica Simpson), transfers to their store. Zack is instantly smitten, but Amy prefers Vince. Zack determines that the only way to win her is to win his store's most coveted honor.

programme.title: Escape from New York
programme.desc: In 1997, a major war between the United States and the Soviet Union is concluding, and the entire island of Manhattan has been converted into a giant maximum security prison. When Air Force One is hijacked and crashes into the island, the president is taken hostage by a group of inmates. Snake Plissken, a former Special Forces soldier turned criminal, is recruited to retrieve the president in exchange for his own freedom.

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a comet causes a radiation storm on Earth, machines come to life and turn against their makers. Holed up in a North Carolina truck stop, a group of survivors must fend for themselves against a mass of homicidal trucks. A diner cook, Bill Robinson (Emilio Estevez), emerges as the unlikely leader of the pack, attempting to find an escape plan for himself and the survivors, who include his boss, Bubba Hendershot (Pat Hingle), and a newlywed couple.

programme.title: I, Frankenstein
programme.desc: Two centuries after Dr. Frankenstein assembles and reanimates his creature, Adam is still living. He becomes embroiled in a war between two immortal races: gargoyles, the traditional protectors of mankind, and evil demons. Since Adam is neither human nor demon, gargoyle Queen Leonore and demon Prince Naberius each want him for their own purposes. It is up to Adam to discover his inner humanity and the reason for his continued existence.

programme.desc: When scientist Dr. Carrington (Robert Cornthwaite) reports a UFO near his North Pole research base, the Air Force sends in a team under Capt. They bring their discovery back to the base, but Carrington and Hendry disagree over what to do with it. Meanwhile, the creature is accidentally thawed and begins wreaking havoc.

programme.desc: FBI agents (Christopher Meloni, Dave Bautista) uncover a conspiracy while trying to nail a group of deadly bank robbers.

programme.title: No Escape
programme.desc: American businessman Jack Dwyer, wife Annie and their two young daughters arrive in Southeast Asia to begin a new life. As his company plans to improve the region's water quality, the family quickly learns that they're right in the middle of a political uprising. Armed rebels attack the hotel where they're staying, ordered to kill any foreigners that they encounter. Amid the chaos, Jack must find a way to save himself and his loved ones from the violence erupting all around them.

programme.title: Paradise City

programme.title: Redemption
programme.desc: Joey, an alcoholic war veteran assumes a new identity after returning from a traumatic tour in Afghanistan and becomes a vigilante in a bid to atone for his sins.

programme.title: I Can Do Bad All by Myself
programme.desc: Madea catches teenage Jennifer and her two younger brothers looting her home. She decides to take matters into her own hands and delivers the young delinquents to the only relative they have, their aunt April, who wants nothing to do with the kids.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Meet the Browns
programme.desc: Single mother Brenda (Angela Bassett) suddenly loses her job, then she receives news that the father she never met is dead. With nothing to lose, she gathers her brood and heads to Georgia, where she meets her father's uproarious family for the first time and finds the tentative beginnings of a new romance.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Good Deeds
programme.desc: For all his life, wealthy businessman Wesley Deeds (Tyler Perry) has done what's expected of him and has settled into a predictable routine. His life begins to change, however, when he meets Lindsey Wakefield (Thandie Newton), a struggling single mother who has just been evicted. Wesley offers to help Lindsey get back on her feet and, though he's already engaged, romantic sparks begin to fly. Suddenly, Wesley finds himself torn between what is expected of him and what he really wants.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's the Family That Preys
programme.desc: Despite their differences in social class, Charlotte (Kathy Bates) and Alice (Alfre Woodard) are good friends for many years. Then secrets, greed and scandal surrounding both their families throw the women's lives into turmoil. Charlotte and Alice set out on a road trip across the country, hoping to gain perspective and save the situation from ruin.

programme.title: The Single Moms Club
programme.desc: When their children face expulsion because of rule infractions, five single mothers must agree to organize the school's upcoming dance and fundraiser. Although they range from alpha professional to fast-food worker, the women find they have one thing in common: a need for support and an understanding ear. They form the Single Moms Club to help ease one another's burdens and reclaim their freedom. As their stress begins to lessen, the women find that finding love may be possible again.

programme.title: Rambo
programme.desc: Having long-since abandoned his life as a lethal soldier, John Rambo (Sylvester Stallone) lives a solitary life near the Thai border. Two weeks after guiding a missionary (Julie Benz) and her comrades into Burma, he gets an urgent call for help. The missionaries have not returned, and although he is reluctant to embrace violence again, Rambo sets out to rescue the captives from the Burmese army.

programme.title: Rambo: Last Blood
programme.desc: Vietnam War veteran John Rambo tries to find some semblance of peace by raising horses on a ranch in Arizona. He's also developed a special familial bond with a woman named Maria and her teenage granddaughter Gabriela. But when a vicious Mexican cartel kidnaps Gabriela, Rambo crosses the border on a bloody and personal quest to rescue her and punish those responsible.

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: Mercenary leader Barney Ross and his loyal men take on what they think is a routine assignment: a covert operation to invade the South American country of Vilena and overthrow its dictator. But, when they learn that the job will be a suicide mission, they must choose redemption or the destruction of their brotherhood.

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: Mercenary leader Barney Ross (Sylvester Stallone), Lee Christmas (Jason Statham) and the rest of the Expendables team reunite when Mr. Church (Bruce Willis) hires them for a seemingly easy job. But things go terribly wrong, compelling the mercenaries to seek revenge for a comrade's murder. With the odds against them, Barney and his team are hell-bent on payback and cut a path of destruction through opposing forces, only to encounter an unexpected threat: six pounds of weapons-grade plutonium.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Years ago, Barney Ross co-founded the Expendables with Conrad Stonebanks. After Stonebanks became an arms dealer, Ross was forced to kill him -- or so he thought. Now, Stonebanks is back, and he's on a mission to end the Expendables. Ross decides that the way to fight old blood is with new blood, so he assembles a team of younger, faster, more tech-savvy recruits. The battle to topple Stonebanks becomes a clash of old-school methods vs. high-tech expertise.

programme.title: The Expendables 4
programme.desc: Armed with every weapon they can get their hands on, the Expendables are the world's last line of defense and the team that gets called when all other options are off the table.

programme.desc: Nick O'Brien is the hard-drinking leader of the Regulators, an elite unit of the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department. programme.desc: Sparks fly between a physical therapist and an injured tennis star who is temporarily living at a tropical resort.

programme.title: Steps of Faith: Hope's Journey
programme.desc: Samson finds his way back to God.

programme.title: Programming Will Return at 6 AM EST
programme.desc: Programming will return at 6 AM Eastern Standard Time (5 AM CST).

programme.title: Finding Love in Quarantine
programme.desc: Forced into quarantine, single father Rick Baldwin tries to keep his sanity while searching for love online.

programme.title: The Girl Who Believes in Miracles
programme.desc: When young Sara hears a preacher say faith can move mountains, she starts praying. Suddenly, people in her town are mysteriously healed -- but fame soon takes its toll.

programme.title: Wedding Screeners
programme.desc: When a late wife's last wish is for her husband to remarry, his daughters insist on prescreening potential candidates, soon realizing that happiness might not be as simple as checking all the boxes.

programme.title: Champion
programme.desc: Dirt track racer Sean Weathers (Andrew Cheney) was at the top of his game with an unstoppable career. When a rivalry with another racer turns personal, the ego that propelled him to success causes a tragedy, sending his life into a tailspin. Jack Reed (Gary Graham) had prospered as a businessman but failed as a family man. In a sudden turn of events, his chances for reconciliation are ripped from his grasp. Sean and Jack's lives collide, and an unexpected bond forms between them.

programme.title: Prescription for Love
programme.desc: A nurse fights for a chance at love with a new doctor and for a promotion to free herself from the misery her supervisor creates. As her supervisor tries to derail her chance at happiness, she learns to stand up for herself and go after her dreams.

programme.title: Making Him Famous
programme.desc: Inspirational speaker Mario King pursues fame, but temptation leads him down a path of destruction. When forced to take community service work at a homeless shelter, Mario finds his faith and his calling.

programme.title: Un día a la vez con Julio Vaqueiro
Un día a la vez con Julio Vaqueiro
Noticias en positivo AHORA
programme.desc: Un resumen de las buenas noticias del día.

programme.title: The Third Reich in Color
programme.desc: During the war with the Soviet Union, 35mm color footage was used for Nazi propaganda. Hitler's pilot filmed his visit to the front lines. Meanwhile, Hollywood director John Ford captured stunning color scenes in North Africa. A camera crew, sent by President Roosevelt, recorded the 1943 Casablanca Conference, where the Allies demanded the unconditional surrender of Nazi Germany.

programme.title: Impossible Peace
programme.desc: Little more than 20 years after the guns fell silent, they roar back into life. Hitler annexes all of Czechoslovakia. Britain and France respond with promises to Poland.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War
programme.desc: When Hitler claimed restitution of Sudetenland, France and Britain abandoned their ally. Ignoring offers to help defend the Czechs, French leaders met with Hitler in Munich in Sep. 1938. Hitler performed like a statesmen, and French leaders signed a treaty that was in fact a death warrant for their own countries. Hitler felt that the floodgates were open and the wave became unstoppable.

programme.title: War Machines
programme.desc: Speed and strategy have always defined warfare. This episode explores the evolution of battlefield mobility-from chariots and cavalry to Humvees and tanks. Highlighting the most iconic and influential combat vehicles, including WWII's infamous tanks, we reveal how movement has been a decisive force in shaping tactics, winning battles, and revolutionizing modern war logistics.

programme.title: World War II: The Real Mighty Eighth
programme.desc: 'Black Week' 1943 sees the worst casualties to date with missions bombing ever deeper into Germany. Veterans describe atrocities committed against captured aircrew, and The Mighty 8th set about crushing Nazi industry, preparing for invasion, destroying the Luftwaffe, reaching Berlin, smashing Hitler's Third Reich, and bringing to an end, the greatest conflict the world has ever known.

programme.title: Weapons of War: Combat on the Russian Front
programme.desc: Documentary charting the battles waged on the Russian Front in the Second World War. The events which occurred are seen by some as the most barbaric conflict in human history

programme.title: German Armour: The Panzer III
programme.desc: It was Heinz Guderian who in 1934, gave specifications for 2 frontline tanks to be manufactured. The first was intended to be the main battle tank of the Panzer divisions capable of destroying enemy tanks. It was called the Panzer 3. Crewed by 5 men, its weight varied at around 20 tons during the campaign in the west, and achieved a top speed of 25 mph. Its main armament was a 37 mm canon.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: The Allies cross the Rhine River into Germany in the early part of 1945. The Canadians cross in February, followed by the Americans and British, with the Americans taking Cologne and crossing river at Remagen. Winston Churchill visits the front and crosses the river himself in a landing boat.

programme.title: U.X.B. Unexploded Bomb Disposal WWII England
programme.desc: A fascinating British Military Training Film dealing with the reconnaissance, identification, and reporting of unexploded bombs or U.X.B. during WWII. A interesting time capsule showing the horrors or The Blitz.

programme.title: The Concise History of WWII
programme.desc: This 3-part program concludes with the liberation of the concentration caps and the arrests and trials of the surviving Nazi leaders for war crimes. The end of the Second World War.

programme.title: German Armour: The Panzer III
programme.desc: It was Heinz Guderian who in 1934, gave specifications for 2 frontline tanks to be manufactured. The first was intended to be the main battle tank of the Panzer divisions capable of destroying enemy tanks. It was called the Panzer 3. Crewed by 5 men, its weight varied at around 20 tons during the campaign in the west, and achieved a top speed of 25 mph. Its main armament was a 37 mm canon.

programme.title: Impossible Peace
programme.desc: Little more than 20 years after the guns fell silent, they roar back into life. Hitler annexes all of Czechoslovakia. Britain and France respond with promises to Poland.

programme.title: German Armour: The Panzer III
programme.desc: It was Heinz Guderian who in 1934, gave specifications for 2 frontline tanks to be manufactured. The first was intended to be the main battle tank of the Panzer divisions capable of destroying enemy tanks. It was called the Panzer 3. Crewed by 5 men, its weight varied at around 20 tons during the campaign in the west, and achieved a top speed of 25 mph. Its main armament was a 37 mm canon.

programme.title: 3 Days in the Life of Lt. Kravtsov
programme.desc: Lt. Kravtsov, a platoon commander, begins his active duty. The odds are against him, as lieutenants typically have only three days to live. Within this time, he must lead his troops in a futile attack, hoping to save the incoming regiment. Can he survive these three days?

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The Big Battles
programme.desc: The advance of the Red Army towards Berlin in the final months of WWII.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: The end of the Korean War and a review of the United Nations that fought against the North.

programme.title: The Attackers
programme.desc: Amidst enemy forces gathering, a Luftwaffe squadron guards above, raising suspicions of troop relocation. A pilot's sacrifice, underwater tanks, and strategists' debates add to tensions. The mission is to destroy the enemy crossing without battles. Pilots reflect on their future amid potential encirclement and lack of aviation devices.

programme.title: The Vietnam War: Unknown Images
programme.desc: From snake-infested jungles to treacherous underground tunnel complexes to city streets, U.S. Infantrymen had to fight in all terrains in Vietnam. Superb combat footage records the war as it raged both in the countryside and in the cities of Saigon and Hue during the Tet Offensive of 1968.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: We follow the supplies from the factory to the depot in the U.S., to the port to the front line unit in Korea. We show the Port of Embarkation, small boats, the ducks, the rail lines, the trucks. And we show a new development of the TC... the helicopter transportation company in training.

programme.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Reconnaissance Aircraft
programme.desc: Reconnaissance aircraft play a significant role in both war and peace time. This program looks at several planes that were deployed in this crucial activity including the RA-5C, the Lockheed SR-71 Blackbird, PC3 Orion and the Grumman E-2 Hawkeye.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: The Troops of Operation Torch come from the U.S. and Britain. U.S. industry is shown going to full war production. Equipment is shown being loaded up for transport to North Africa, and the landings are made successfully.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: This program includes a tribute to the men of the Infantry from an officer who served with them as a platoon leader, Lieutenant Robert Fallon of Washington, D.C. Lieutenant Fallon points out the difficult but important job of the man carrying the rifle in combat. Captain Zimmerman interviews Master Sergeant Heidenreith, also of Washington, D.C. Sergeant Heidenreith was a combat engineer in Korea.

programme.title: U.X.B. Unexploded Bomb Disposal WWII England

programme.desc: Munich was closely tied to National Socialism, where the Nazi movement, SA, and SS were founded. Rare footage shows Hitler visiting construction sites in Munich's transformed areas.

programme.title: War Machines
programme.desc: Whether revered or reviled, the invention of the gun forever changed how wars are fought and won. From humble beginnings to a tool that built empires, toppled kingdoms, and killed millions, its story is one of power and evolution. This episode explores the gun's transformation over centuries and its influence on the battlefield, in politics, and in shaping the very course of human history.

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: The Alps Front, June 1940. A handful of French soldiers are about to face a flood of 300,000 Italians. Everywhere in France, you see defeat. The Government fled to Bordeaux on June 14th. While France is breaking down, General Olry and his men remain stationed on the Alps. During ten days of fierce battle, the Italians will lose more than 6,000 men without seizing an inch of French territory.

programme.title: Great Battles of The Civil War: Volume 1
programme.desc: Volume 1 - 1861-1863. This in depth volume combines archival material with faithfully created battle re-enactments to depict the real horror and heroism of the American Civil War combat from 1861-1863. Witness the sacrifice of over 600,000 patriots in fierce hand-to-hand combat and face-to-face warfare struggling to preserve their ways of life.

programme.title: Animals at War: Wild Heroes of World War II
programme.desc: Fifty million people died in the WWII, the biggest massacre in the history of humanity. This included combat animals, animals that backed up humans, those that entertained or consoled them, some that fed people, and other animals that were symbols.

programme.desc: A look at the Battle of the Gothic Line from an American Soldier and a soldier from the German Wehrmacht. Also features bonus footage of the Battle Of The Bulge.

programme.title: Scorched Earth: Hitler's Big Guns
programme.desc: Ground-breaking 3D graphics and state-of-the-art computer animation provide some of the highlights in this authoritative, entertaining look at the great German siege guns of World War Two. The programme features extraordinary archive footage culled from German and Allied sources and all-new footage of surviving examples of German heavy artillery.

programme.title: Air Power
programme.desc: The 1930's bring remarkable advances in military flight and provide Germany and Japan with decisive advantages in the air as World War II begins. The Germans pound London in the Battle of the Blitz while Japanese naval aviation brings the United States into the war with the attack on Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: World War II: The Sound and the Fury
programme.desc: Stalingrad breaks the Nazi advance; Japan falters at Guadalcanal. The tide begins to turn. Mussolini falls as Allies land in Sicily. The Soviets crush Germany at Kursk. Allied tech improves-radar, codebreaking, bombing raids. War spreads into the skies. In Tehran, Roosevelt, Churchill, and Stalin prepare for D-Day. The drive to defeat fascism gathers momentum.

programme.title: Scorched Earth: Propaganda
programme.desc: There are many weapons of war; fighter planes, heavy tanks and skilled infantrymen but it could be argued that none is more powerful than the power of suggestion. Propaganda and the war of words played an undoubtedly vital role in both the successes and failures of WW2. Governments struggled to gain the upper hand. But one Nazi proved to have a deft talent for spin. Joseph Goebbels.

programme.title: The Third Reich in Color
programme.desc: During the war with the Soviet Union, 35mm color footage was used for Nazi propaganda. Hitler's pilot filmed his visit to the front lines. Meanwhile, Hollywood director John Ford captured stunning color scenes in North Africa. A camera crew, sent by President Roosevelt, recorded the 1943 Casablanca Conference, where the Allies demanded the unconditional surrender of Nazi Germany.

programme.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Reconnaissance Aircraft
programme.desc: Reconnaissance aircraft play a significant role in both war and peace time. This program looks at several planes that were deployed in this crucial activity including the RA-5C, the Lockheed SR-71 Blackbird, PC3 Orion and the Grumman E-2 Hawkeye.

programme.title: Great Battles of The Civil War: Volume 1
programme.desc: Volume 1 - 1861-1863. This in depth volume combines archival material with faithfully created battle re-enactments to depict the real horror and heroism of the American Civil War combat from 1861-1863. Witness the sacrifice of over 600,000 patriots in fierce hand-to-hand combat and face-to-face warfare struggling to preserve their ways of life.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: An in-depth look at the air war over Japan during WWII, including the Doolittle Raid, B-29 attacks, and the nuclear bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

programme.title: War Machines
programme.desc: Whether revered or reviled, the invention of the gun forever changed how wars are fought and won. From humble beginnings to a tool that built empires, toppled kingdoms, and killed millions, its story is one of power and evolution. This episode explores the gun's transformation over centuries and its influence on the battlefield, in politics, and in shaping the very course of human history.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: This program includes a tribute to the men of the Infantry from an officer who served with them as a platoon leader, Lieutenant Robert Fallon of Washington, D.C. Lieutenant Fallon points out the difficult but important job of the man carrying the rifle in combat. Captain Zimmerman interviews Master Sergeant Heidenreith, also of Washington, D.C. Sergeant Heidenreith was a combat engineer in Korea.

programme.title: Weapons of War: Combat on the Russian Front
programme.desc: Documentary charting the battles waged on the Russian Front in the Second World War. The events which occurred are seen by some as the most barbaric conflict in human history

programme.title: Exploring Hitler's Berlin/Munich
programme.desc: Munich was closely tied to National Socialism, where the Nazi movement, SA, and SS were founded. Hitler called it the 'capital of the movement' and planned grandiose architectural projects. Though most plans weren't realized, landmarks like the 'Haus der Kunst' and parts of the party district still stand today. Rare footage shows Hitler visiting construction sites in Munich's transformed areas.

programme.title: Weapons of War: Combat on the Russian Front

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: The Alps Front, June 1940. A handful of French soldiers are about to face a flood of 300,000 Italians. Everywhere in France, you see defeat. The Government fled to Bordeaux on June 14th. While France is breaking down, General Olry and his men remain stationed on the Alps. During ten days of fierce battle, the Italians will lose more than 6,000 men without seizing an inch of French territory.

programme.title: 3 Days in the Life of Lt. Kravtsov
programme.desc: Lt. Kravtsov, a platoon commander, begins his active duty. The odds are against him, as lieutenants typically have only three days to live. Within this time, he must lead his troops in a futile attack, hoping to save the incoming regiment. Can he survive these three days?

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: In the early 1480s, Leonardo Da Vinci designed an aerial screw. Its intended use was unknown, yet served as the inspiration for the helicopter. Developments over the years have seen the Helicopter becoming more involved in troop transport, including airlifting the wounded directly to hospitals. Today's attack Helicopters show the versatility of this war machine.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: Germany's retreat continues as the Allies liberate France and Belgium. Montgomery's ambition to end the war risks more than his reputation as the push toward the Netherlands begins.

programme.title: WWII: Capitulation
programme.desc: May 8, 1945. While the Allied troops were parading through liberated towns to cheering crowds, the Second World War was in its final, apocalyptic hours. The weeks preceding the end of the conflict would usher in a new world. The Soviets, more powerful than ever, invaded conquered territories and terrorized survivors. The last Nazi soldiers attempted to escape their inevitable fates.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War
programme.desc: To Adolf Hitler in 1940, Britain was no more than an irritant on his periphery to his rapidly expanding Third Reich. He was correct in his assumption that Britain had been almost fatally weakened by the fight of Dunkirk. If Britain were to be subdued, there seemed to be no more auspicious time than 1940. The Luftwaffe had proven themselves invincible, which filled them with pride and enthusiasm.

programme.title: The Bomber: Terror of World War II
programme.desc: The Blitz shook Britain, but the Allies struck back harder with strategic bombing. Technology advanced-radar, gun turrets, and bomb sights changed everything. Civil defenses rose. After Pearl Harbor, the US joined in, bringing more bombers, more power, and a new level of destruction to the war.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: This episode offers a gripping historical account of the pivotal New Guinea campaign during World War II, highlighting the challenges and ultimate triumph of the Allied forces.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: On September 1, 1939, Germany invaded Poland in a blitzkrieg fueled not only by tactics and technology, but also by Pervitin-crystal meth. Developed in 1938, this 'miracle pill' boosted soldiers' endurance and morale, becoming a weapon of war. Declassified files, including Hitler's medical records, uncover Project D-IX and reveal how meth shaped Nazi power and altered the course of history.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: Wehrmacht Major Otto Link seeks revenge on Soviet pilots who foiled his mission and wiped out saboteurs. At HQ he unveils a night-vision device in his Messerschmitt, letting it fly unseen in darkness. The Germans, aware of an imminent Soviet infantry assault on the bridgehead, prepare a deadly surprise for the bombers-an invisible Messer.

programme.title: Sword of Honour
programme.desc: The story is one man's heroic quest to fight for a deep moral cause and to reclaim his manhood after a shattering divorce from society beauty Virginia Troy.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: On 18 May 1939, the Nazis opened Ravensbrück, the largest women's concentration camp. Of the 130,000 women and children deported, 90,000 died. Through survivor testimonies, expert insights, 3D models, and reconstructions, this film reveals the camp's brutal conditions and the remarkable resilience of those who endured its horrors.

programme.title: The U-Boat War
programme.desc: Twenty years after the defeat of Kaiser Wilhem the II, the German navy, The Kriegsmarine, had once again grown into a powerful weapon, nurtured this time through Hitler's Third Reich. By 1939, Germany was eager and ready to wipe out the stain of her naval history and possessed a terrifying weapon that made sure Hitler's visions were realized - The U Boat.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: History, organization, and capability of the cavalry division (airmobile) with focus on deployment in South Vietnam.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: On September 1, 1939, Germany invaded Poland in a blitzkrieg fueled not only by tactics and technology, but also by Pervitin-crystal meth. Developed in 1938, this 'miracle pill' boosted soldiers' endurance and morale, becoming a weapon of war. Declassified files, including Hitler's medical records, uncover Project D-IX and reveal how meth shaped Nazi power and altered the course of history.

programme.title: The Reich Underground
programme.desc: Today, many of the half-built facilities have been long-forgotten. With previously unreleased film material and exclusive interviews, the fascinating and dramatic story of the Underground Reich is reconstructed when the Nazis leaders still hoped that the miracle weapons they produced would bring Germany final victory.

programme.title: The Crimean War
programme.desc: This program looks at the epic charge of the Light Brigade, when a misunderstood Order sent troops straight into the main Russian artillery during the Battle of Balaclava. It also looks at the later Battle of Inkerman and the work of Florence Nightingale.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: On 18 May 1939, the Nazis opened Ravensbrück, the largest women's concentration camp. Of the 130,000 women and children deported, 90,000 died. Through survivor testimonies, expert insights, 3D models, and reconstructions, this film reveals the camp's brutal conditions and the remarkable resilience of those who endured its horrors.

programme.title: The Attackers
programme.desc: During WWII, a squadron faces a treacherous airdrome mission. Bordeaux loses film, compromising the op. They celebrate a victory but face danger later. A pilot reveals fatigue and refuses duty. Charged as a coward, he returns home to a different life. War impacts loved ones, and exemptions stir emotions.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: 'Independence Day in Europe - In France, Eisenhower observes General Bradley fire a giant howitzer signaling our artillery into a massed crescendo of fire. Following the landing battles in Normandy, the Canadians return to the thick of the fighting at Cariquet. So severe that some Canadian camera crew were killed. In their sector, the Yanks are blazing through the hedge rows with grenade guns.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: Wehrmacht Major Otto Link seeks revenge on Soviet pilots who foiled his mission and wiped out saboteurs. At HQ he unveils a night-vision device in his Messerschmitt, letting it fly unseen in darkness. The Germans, aware of an imminent Soviet infantry assault on the bridgehead, prepare a deadly surprise for the bombers-an invisible Messer.

programme.title: Sword of Honour
programme.desc: The story is one man's heroic quest to fight for a deep moral cause and to reclaim his manhood after a shattering divorce from society beauty Virginia Troy.

programme.title: WWII: Capitulation
programme.desc: May 8, 1945. While the Allied troops were parading through liberated towns to cheering crowds, the Second World War was in its final, apocalyptic hours. The weeks preceding the end of the conflict would usher in a new world. The Soviets, more powerful than ever, invaded conquered territories and terrorized survivors. The last Nazi soldiers attempted to escape their inevitable fates.

programme.title: Annihilation: The Destruction of European Jews
programme.desc: By June 1940, Nazi Germany had occupied Paris. France was cut in two. North of the demarcation line was the German-occupied zone and to the south was a zone headed by Marshal Pétain, whose seat of government was in the central spa town of Vichy. The Vichy regime very quickly, and without pressure from the Germans, passed the first Jewish laws.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: During this hour, witness the World shaking events that took place of the years immediately preceding WW2. You'll also see the Nazi subjugation of France and England's heroic defense in the Battle of Britain. Pearl Harbor is also discussed.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: During this hour, witness the World shaking events that took place of the years immediately preceding WW2. You'll also see the Nazi subjugation of France and England's heroic defense in the Battle of Britain. Pearl Harbor is also discussed.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: Before 1941 was half over, the Soviet Union was locked in struggle with Germany. Before the year was out, humanity would be hanging on the fate of Roosevelt's great union, compelled to join the struggle by what he termed 'a date which will live in infamy.'

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Big Slim is an aviation legend. During a nail-biting engagement in the skies over Europe, Sgt Fred 'Big Slim' Richardson's tall frame was struck by thirty-six pieces of shrapnel. To any other man, such wounds would have been fatal, but Big Slim was different, toughing it out to lead his unit to victory. Such courage sees the Sergeant remembered even all these years later. Stars Jim Hutton.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Reaching the heart of Hitler's Third Reich brought some of the war's bloodiest battles. As East Company, 253rd Regiment, 63rd Infantry advanced through Untergresheim to secure a vital bridge over the River Jagst, they realized they were without an officer. In their moment of need, Sgt. Webb and Private First-Class Brad Fisher took up the challenge and took command.

programme.title: First to Fight
programme.desc: North Korea crosses the 38th Parallel and invades South Korea on June 25, 1950. The North pushes through initial defenses and captures Seoul and US and UN forces dig in at Pusan.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: Our patrols in probing actions... The attack on Hill 1179... The return of Seoul refugees... and more of the ceasefire negotiations. Two combat cameramen of the Army Signal Corps are interviewed, Corporal John Romanowski of Chicago, Illinois, and Sergeant Lee Marks of Providence, Rhode Island. They tell a dramatic story of filming our troops for the newsreels and for 'The Big Picture.'

programme.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Fighter Aircraft - WWI
programme.desc: Providing exact numbers, specifications, and plenty of facts, Military Aircraft of the 20th Century provides an encyclopedic look at aircrafts used by any military force in the 20th century. This entry discusses the fighters of WWI, like the Nieuport 17, Albatross, Sopwith Camel, Fokker, and many more.

programme.title: David Jason's Secret Service: The Story of Britain's Rich Spy History
programme.desc: Sir David searches out Britain's eccentric amateur inventors and backyard boffins, who played a key role in the defeat of Hitler and created the machinery of 21st-century surveillance.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: The downed 'Messer' crashes in a forest but doesn't explode. Both Germans and Soviet scouts race to recover its night-vision device. Its creator, German scientist Holts, also seeks it, tracking Soviet moves and anticipating the Swallows' aerial reconnaissance. The wreck lies in a swamp, making recovery far more difficult.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: Germany's retreat continues as the Allies liberate France and Belgium. Montgomery's ambition to end the war risks more than his reputation as the push toward the Netherlands begins.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: One of the reasons for the success of the D-Day landings was the element of surprise, the huge invasion force, congregating along the south coast of England went undetected by German Intelligence.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: As the liberation of France got underway, the citizens of a nation oppressed since 1940 celebrated the Allied arrival with rapture. There was still much to be achieved, on both the Western and Eastern Fronts. For Hitler the writing was on the wall.

programme.title: D-Day: 100 Days for Freedom
programme.desc: From the hedgerows of Normandy to the liberation of Paris, this episode retraces the 100 critical days after D-Day. Witness the fierce battles, the resilience of soldiers, and the toll on civilians as the Allies push through German defenses, paving the way for Europe's liberation and altering the course of World War II.

programme.title: First to Fight
programme.desc: With U.S. and U.N. forces locked in the struggle to break out from Pusan , MacArthur put in place what was perhaps the most remembered aspect of the Korean War: The amphibious landing at Inchon.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: In 2016, over 200 unseen photos of Nazi officials surfaced, revealing the rise of a young Hitlerite group in concentration camps between 1928-1943. Dr. Stefan Hördler spent 5 years analyzing the images, uncovering how these men became perpetrators of horrific crimes. This investigation exposes a little-known chapter of the camps and challenges assumptions about their origins.

programme.title: 3 Days in the Life of Lt. Kravtsov
programme.desc: This story underscores the harsh realities of war and the profound impact it has on young soldiers like Lt. Kravtsov. It raises questions about sacrifice, the fragility of life, and the emotional toll of warfare. Will Lt. Kravtsov defy the odds and survive his assigned three days? The answer remains uncertain in this poignant narrative of youth and the cost of war.

programme.title: Auschwitz - Voices of 44 Survivors
programme.desc: The concentration camp deportees became the rare witnesses to mass extermination.

programme.title: Visions of War: U.S. Marines
programme.desc: Fury in the Pacific is a documentary about a pair of World War II battles in the Pacific: the Battle of Peleliu and the Battle of Angaur. It was co-produced by the U.S. Army, U.S. Navy, and the U.S. Marines, and directed by a series of combat cameraman. The film is noteworthy for its praise of the fighting abilities of Japanese soldiers, and its fast-paced editing.

programme.title: The Vietnam War: Jungles of Death
programme.desc: The story of the Vietnam War from the perspective of both sides, including rare war time footage from North Vietnamese sources.

programme.title: The Bomber: Terror of World War II
programme.desc: In 1939, bombers hit Polish cities, sparking fear and evacuations. By 1940, Britain faced the Blitz, though early German raids targeted airfields. Both Axis and Allies believed air attacks could break morale. The war revealed that bombing had no boundaries-and civilians were on the front lines.

programme.title: Grey Wolves Part 1: The Killing Begins
programme.desc: Kaiser Wilhelm the 2nd of Germany had long desired to rule an empire. He thought that Germany needed a powerful Navy to protect it - especially against Britain. The Germany Navy was set to the ultimate test - war against Great Britain, putting their mighty fleet to good use. They began a naval blockade of Germany during the first days of the war and deployed their naval units.

programme.title: WWII War Diaries
programme.desc: In this first film of the series, '1939', follow the prelude to war and consider how the Treaty of Versailles, drawn up after the First World War, failed to keep the peace. Watch the rise of Adolf Hitler and Nazi Germany and learn of those who attempted to stop his bid for global domination. See for yourself the preparations made by the people of Britain as war became inevitable.

programme.title: Patton's Finest Hour: The Battle Of The Bulge
programme.desc: Story of the three-day attack on St. Vith and retreat of American troops when the town was lost to the Germans. Fighting by 84th infantry division in Battle of the Bulge, crossing of the Roer and Rhine, and the desperate race to the Elbe.

programme.title: The Tiger Files
programme.desc: An in detail look at the Tiger Tank from drawing board to the battlefield.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: Operation Dewey Canyon, from January 22 through March 18, 1969, was the last major offensive by the United States Marine Corps during the Vietnam War. The 9th Marine Regiment reinforced by elements of the 3rd Marine Regiment swept through the A Shau Valley engaging in 56 days of combat mainly against the North Vietnamese Army.

programme.title: First to Fight
programme.desc: The advance continues in North Korea closing to the Korean/China border. As winter starts American forces encounter Chinese troops for the first time. The Marines advance to the Chosin Reservoir.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: 'Tell it to the Chaplain' is a favorite expression of servicemen. This is the tale of a chaplain who, every Sunday, held services amidst ear-splitting gunfire in the fox holes. But when their officer was wounded, the men didn't need a Chaplain, they needed leadership to face oncoming Germans. This Chaplain didn't let his boys down, improving leadership, not taught at O.C.S., to repel the attack.

programme.title: Heroes Never Die: The Miniseries
programme.desc: With English Closed Captions. A group of Ukrainian Army fighters heads to Donetsk airport for its defense. After being shelled by artillery on the way, a team of four volunteer fighters makes it to the airport to help reinforce. The name Cyborgs, Defenders of the Donetsk Airport, is given to the Ukrainian fighters for their grit, bravery and heroics.

programme.title: War in the Pacific
programme.desc: Tensions begin to rise in Korea.

programme.title: Bomber Operations: Target For Tonight
programme.desc: 1941 Film - The planning and implementation of an RAF night raid on Germany in World War II, concentrating on a low level mission by a Wellington bomber on an oil storage facility by the Rhine.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: On July 25th, 1943, Benito Mussolini is ousted from power. We then flashback to his rise to power, including the Fascist march on Rome in November, 1922. In 1936 Ethiopia is invaded. The Axis Pact is proclaimed in 1938, followed by the invasion of Albania in 1939. In 1940, Italy gets into the Second World War, and invades Greece and Egypt, only to be defeated.

programme.desc: Morgan Hickman is a tough gunslinger with a knack for keeping his cool in tense situations. When he wanders into a town where the local lawman has been killed, he finds callow but eager Ben Owens temporarily acting as sheriff. Soon Ben, who wants to keep his new position, is looking to Morgan for guidance. Though the bounty hunter has his own issues with law enforcement, he admires Ben's enthusiasm and decides to train him to be an effective sheriff.

programme.title: Silverado
programme.desc: Rambling man Emmett (Scott Glenn) assembles a group of misfit cowboys (Kevin Costner), (Kevin Kline, Danny Glover). After helping a group of settlers track down a pack of thieves, Emmett and his men descend on the troubled town of Silverado to seek their fortunes. Soon after arriving, they discover that the town has fallen into the grasp of greedy rancher Ethan McKendrick (Ray Baker) and corrupt Sheriff Cobb (Brian Dennehy) with whom many of Emmett's men have unfinished business.

programme.title: Two Mules for Sister Sara
programme.desc: When gunslinger Hogan (Clint Eastwood) discovers a group of men attempting to rape a young nun, Sara (Shirley MacLaine), he shoots them dead and rescues the woman. The two escape to a nearby camp of Mexican revolutionaries, who have hired Hogan to help fight the invading French army. En route, Sara turns out to be surprisingly crude for a nun, drinking, smoking and using curse words. When she also proves to be handy with a gun, Hogan begins wondering if she is telling him the whole truth.

programme.title: Joe Kidd
programme.desc: In New Mexico, one-time bounty hunter Joe Kidd owns a ranch where a nearby group of Mexican revolutionaries, led by Luis Chama, fights for their rightful land after the U.S. government denies their claims. In response, a greedy landowner gathers a posse to capture Chama and solicits Kidd's assistance. Kidd, who has no interest in the matter, changes his mind when he discovers Chama has stolen a horse and roughed up a worker from his ranch.

programme.title: High Plains Drifter
programme.desc: In this Western, a drifter with no name wanders into a small town, where his gun-slinging abilities are in high demand. When the drifter rides into Lago, he is met with incredulity and disapproval by the townspeople. But once he shows his skills with a pistol, the locals realize he may be able to help them fend off a band of criminals who have been terrorizing the town. He agrees to help the townspeople, but does so with his own secret agenda.

programme.title: Punisher: War Zone
programme.desc: Frank Castle, aka The Punisher (Ray Stevenson), turns the streets of New York City red as he wages a one-man war against the crime syndicate responsible for the death of his wife and two kids. Aided by his trusted sidekick, Microchip (Wayne Knight), he almost kills Billy Russoti (Dominic West) and leaves him horribly disfigured. Billy renames himself Jigsaw and with the help of his crazed brother Loony Bin Jim, recruits criminals from every corner of the city to do battle with Frank.

programme.title: Dredd
programme.desc: Mega City One is a vast, violent metropolis where felons rule the streets. The only law lies with cops called "judges," who act as judge, jury and executioner, and Dredd (Karl Urban) is one of the city's most feared. One day, Dredd is partnered with Cassandra (Olivia Thirlby), a rookie with powerful psychic abilities. A report of a terrible crime sends Dredd and Cassandra to a dangerous area controlled by Ma-Ma (Lena Headey), a drug lord who will stop at nothing to protect her empire.

programme.title: Gamer
programme.desc: Each week Kable, a death-row inmate, battles his fellow prisoners in a violent online game called "Slayers," his every move controlled by a young gamer's remote device. To the players, Kable and the other inmates are just simulated characters. But, to a resistance group that opposes the game's inventor, Kable is a critical component of their plan to end the inventor's form of high-tech slavery.

programme.title: Future World
programme.desc: A queen lays dying as her son, Prince, travels across a barren wasteland to find a near-mythical medicine to save her life. After evading violent raiders on motorbikes led by the Warlord and his enforcer, Prince meets Ash, a robotic assassin in search of its own soul. When the Druglord captures Prince, he soon finds himself in an epic battle to save the last remnants of humanity.

programme.title: Freaky Tales
programme.desc: An NBA star, a corrupt cop, a female rap duo, teenage punks, neo-Nazis and a debt collector embark on a collision course in 1987 Oakland, Calif.
